1.1: Kwakukhona umuntu ezweni lase-Uzi ogama lakhe lalinguJobe; lowo muntu wayengenasici elungile, wayemesaba uNkulunkulu, wabalekela okubi.
1.3: Impahla yakhe yayiyizimvu eziyizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa, namakamela ayizinkulungwane ezintathu, namabhangqa angamakhulu ayisihlanu ezinkabi, nezimbongolo zezinsikazi ezingamakhulu ayisihlanu, nezinceku eziningi kakhulu; wayemkhulu lowo muntu kunabo bonke abantu basempumalanga.
1.4: Amadodana akhe ayehamba enza idili endlini yaleyo naleyo ngosuku lwayo; ayesethuma ebiza odadewabo abathathu ukuba badle, baphuze nawo.
1.5: Kwathi lapho seziphelile izinsuku zedili lawo, uJobe wathuma wawangcwelisa, wavuka ekuseni, wanikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa njengomumo wawo onke; ngokuba uJobe wathi: “Mhlawumbe amadodana ami onile, amthukile uNkulunkulu ezinhliziyweni zawo.” Wenze njalo uJobe imihla yonke.
1.6: Kwathi ngelinye ilanga kwafika amadodana kaNkulunkulu ema phambi kukaJehova, kwafika noSathane phakathi kwawo.
1.7: UJehova wayesethi kuSathane: “Uvelaphi na?” USathane wamphendula uJehova, wathi: “Ekuzuleni emhlabeni nasekuhambahambeni kuwo.”
1.8: Wayesethi uJehova kuSathane: “Inhliziyo yakho iyiqaphele inceku yami uJobe na? Ngokuba akakho onjengaye emhlabeni, umuntu ongenasici nolungileyo, omesaba uNkulunkulu, obalekela okubi.”
1.9: USathane wamphendula uJehova, wathi: “UJobe uyamesaba uNkulunkulu ngeze na?
1.10: Wena awumbiyelanga yini yena nendlu yakhe nakho konke okwakhe nxazonke, wabusisa umsebenzi wezandla zakhe na? Impahla yakhe yandile emhlabeni.
1.11: Kepha ake welule isandla sakho, uthinte konke anakho, impela uyakukuthuka ebusweni bakho.”
1.12: Wathi uJehova kuSathane: “Bheka, konke anakho kusesandleni sakho; kuphela kuyena uqobo ungabeki isandla sakho.” Wayesephuma uSathane ebusweni bukaJehova.
1.13: Kwathi ngolunye usuku lapho amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe edla, ephuza iwayini endlini yomfowabo oyizibulo,
1.14: kwafika isithunywa kuJobe, sathi: “Izinkabi bezilima, izimbongolo ziklabile eceleni kwazo,
1.15: lapho amaSheba etheleka, azithatha; izinceku azibulele ngosiko lwenkemba; mina ngedwa kuphela ngisindile, ukuze ngikubikele.”
1.16: Esakhuluma lowo, kwafika nomunye, wathi: “Umlilo kaNkulunkulu uwile ezulwini, washisa izimvu nezinceku, waziqeda; mina ngedwa kuphela ngisindile, ukuze ngikubikele.”
1.17: Esakhuluma lowo, kwafika nomunye, wathi: “AmaKaledi enza amaviyo amathathu, ahlasela amakamela, awathatha, azibulala izinceku ngosiko lwenkemba; mina ngedwa kuphela ngisindile, ukuze ngikubikele.”
1.18: Esakhuluma lowo, kwafika nomunye, wathi: “Amadodana akho namadodakazi akho ayedla, ephuza iwayini endlini yomfowabo oyizibulo;
1.19: bheka, kwafika, kwadabula ihlane umoya omkhulu, washaya amagumbi omane endlu, yawa phezu kwezinsizwa, zafa; mina ngedwa kuphela ngisindile, ukuze ngikubikele.”
1.20: Wayesesukuma uJobe, waklebhula ingubo yakhe, waphucula ikhanda lakhe, wawela emhlabathini, wakhuleka,
1.21: wathi: “Ngaphuma ngize esizalweni sikamame; ngiyakubuyela khona ngize; uJehova wapha, uJehova uthathile; malibongwe igama likaJehova.”
1.22: Kukho konke lokho uJobe akonanga, akamthelanga uNkulunkulu okubi.

2.1: Kwathi futhi ngelinye ilanga afika amadodana kaNkulunkulu, ema phambi kukaJehova; noSathane wafika phakathi kwawo ukuba eme phambi kukaJehova.
2.2: UJehova wathi kuSathane: “Uvelaphi na?” USathane wamphendula uJehova, wathi: “Ekuzuleni emhlabeni nasekuhambahambeni kuwo.”
2.3: Wayesethi uJehova kuSathane: “Inhliziyo yakho iyiqaphele inceku yami uJobe na? Ngokuba akakho onjengaye emhlabeni, umuntu ongenasici nolungileyo, omesaba uNkulunkulu, obalekela okubi; usabambelela ekupheleleni kwakhe, noma ungivusele ukumchitha engenacala.”
2.4: USathane wamphendula uJehova, wathi: “Isikhumba ngesikhumba, yebo, konke umuntu anakho uyakunika ngokuphila kwakhe.
2.5: Kepha ake welule isandla sakho, uthinte amathambo akhe nenyama yakhe, impela uyakukuthuka ebusweni bakho.”
2.6: UJehova wayesethi kuSathane: “Bheka, usesandleni sakho; gcina ukuphila kwakhe kodwa.”
2.7: Wayesephuma uSathane ebusweni bukaJehova, wamshaya uJobe ngamathumba amabi, kusukela ematheni onyawo kuze kufike okhakhayini.
2.8: Wathatha udengezi ukuzozenwaya ngalo; wayehlezi phakathi komlotha.
2.9: Wayesethi umkakhe kuye: “Usabambelela ekupheleleni kwakho na? Thuka uNkulunkulu, ufe.”
2.10: Kepha wathi kuye: “Ukhuluma njengalokhu owesifazane oyisiwula ekhuluma. Siyakwamukela okuhle kuphela kuNkulunkulu, singamukeli nokubi, na?” Kukho konke lokho uJobe akonanga ngomlomo wakhe.
2.11: Lapho abangane abathathu bakaJobe sebezwe ngakho konke lokho okubi okumehleleyo, bafika kuye bevela, kwaba yilowo nalowo endaweni yakhe: ngu-Elifazi umThemani, noBilidadi umShuhi, noSofari umNahama; bavumelana ukuba baye bamkhalele, bamduduze.
2.12: Lapho bephakamisa amehlo abo besekude, abamazanga; badazuluka bakhala, baklebhula, kwaba yilowo nalowo ingubo yakhe, bafafaza amakhanda abo ngothuli beluphonsa phezulu.
2.13: Bahlala phansi naye emhlabathini izinsuku eziyisikhombisa nobusuku obuyisikhombisa, akukhulumanga muntu kuye, ngokuba babona ukuthi usizi lwakhe lwalulukhulu kakhulu.

3.1: Emva kwalokho uJobe wavula umlomo wakhe, waqalekisa usuku lwakhe.
3.3: “Makubhubhe usuku engazalwa ngalo, nobusuku obathi: ‘Ukhulelwe umntwana wesilisa.’
3.4: Lolo suku malube ngubumnyama; uNkulunkulu makangalunaki ephezulu, ukukhanya makungakhanyiswa kulo.
3.5: Ubumnyama nethunzi lokufa maluphiwe khona, kuhlale ifu phezu kwalo; okwenza mnyama usuku makulwesabise.
3.6: Ubusuku lobo isigayegaye masibubambe; mabungajabuli phakathi kwezinsuku zomnyaka, bungangeni phakathi komumo wezinyanga.
3.7: Bheka, lobo busuku mabungabi nalutho, kungangeni ukujabula kubo.
3.8: Mababuqalekise abathuka amalanga, abalungele ukuvusa uLeviyathani.
3.9: Izinkanyezi zokuhwelela kwabo maziphenduke ubumnyama; mabulinde ukukhanya kungabikho, bungaboni izinkophe zokusa,
3.10: ngokuba abuvalanga izivalo zesizalo sikamame, abufihlanga ukuhlupheka emehlweni ami.
3.11: “Angifanga ngani esizalweni na? Angibhubhanga ngani ekuphumeni kwami esiswini na?
3.12: Amadolo angamukeleleni, namabele ukuba ngincele, na?
3.13: Ngokuba kalokhu ngakube ngilele, ngithule; khona ngakube ngilele ubuthongo nginokuphumula
3.14: kanye namakhosi nabeluleki bomhlaba abazakhela izinqaba zamathuna,
3.15: noma kanye nezikhulu ezinegolide ezazigcwalisa izindlu zazo ngesiliva,
3.16: noma ngangingekho njengokuphuphumileyo okuthukusiweyo, njengezingane ezingazange zibone ukukhanya.
3.17: Lapho amashinga ayekile ukudlova; lapho baphumule abaphelile amandla.
3.18: Lapho iziboshwa ziyatabhaya kanyekanye; azizwa izwi labazicindezelayo.
3.19: Lapho nabancane nabakhulu bayafanana; isigqila sikhululekile enkosini yaso.
3.22: abathokoza baze bethabe, bajabule, uma belithola ithuna,
3.23: nomuntu ondlela yakhe isithekile, uNkulunkulu ambiyeleyo nxazonke zakhe, na?
3.24: Ukugquma kwami kufika phambi kwesinkwa sami, nokububula kwami kuthululwa njengamanzi,
3.25: ngokuba engikwesabayo sekuyangifikela, nenginovalo ngakho sekuyangehlela.
3.26: Anginakuthula, angizolile, anginakuphumula; kepha ukuyaluza kuyafika.”

4.2: “Uma kulingwa ukukhulunywa kuwe, uyakukhathazeka na? Kepha ngubani ongazibamba, angakhulumi, na?
4.3: Bheka, uqondisile abaningi; uqinisile izandla ezibuthakathaka.
4.4: Amazwi akho amisile okhubekayo; usimamisile amadolo athuthumelayo.
4.5: “Kepha sekufikile kuwe, uyakhathazeka; kuyakuthinta wena, uyashaywa luvalo.
4.6: Ukumesaba kwakho uNkulunkulu akusilo ithemba lakho yini, nokuphelela kwezindlela zakho akusiso isisekelo sakho na?
4.7: Ake ukhumbule ukuthi ngubani owake wachithwa engenacala na? Babhujiswaphi abalungileyo na?
4.8: Njengokubona kwami abalima okubi bahlwanyele ukona, bayakuvuna.
4.9: Babhubha ngokuphephetha kukaNkulunkulu; ngomoya wentukuthelo yakhe bayaphela.
4.10: Ukubhonga kwengonyama nezwi lebhubesi kuyaphela, namazinyo amabhongo ayaphuka.
4.11: Ibhubesi elinamandla liyabhubha ngokuswela impango; amawundlu ebhubesikazi ayahlakazeka.
4.12: “Kwanyenyiselwa kimi izwi, indlebe yami yabamba ukunyenyezwa kwalo.
4.13: Ngokudlala kwemicabango ivuswe yimibono yasebusuku, lapho abantu sebehlelwe ngubuthongo obunzima,
4.14: ngafikelwa yingebhe nokuthuthumela okwaqhaqhazelisa onke amathambo ami.
4.15: Kwadlula umoya ebusweni bami; uboya bomzimba wami bavuka.
4.16: Kwema okuthile, kepha angaqonda ukubonakala kwakho; isimo sasiphambi kwamehlo ami; kwathula; ngase ngizwa izwi, lathi:
4.17: ‘Umuntu ulungile kunoNkulunkulu na? Umuntukazana uhlambulukile kunoMenzi na?
4.18: Bheka, nasezincekwini zakhe akethembi, nezingelosi zakhe uyazibeka icala;
4.19: kakhulu kangakanani abahlezi ezindlini zodaka, abazisekelo zabo zisothulini, abachotshozwa njengenundu.
4.20: Bagxotshwa kusukela ekuseni kuze kube kusihlwa; babhubha kuze kube phakade benganakwa muntu.
4.21: Intambo yetende labo ayisishulwa yini phakathi kwabo, bafe bengazelele, na?’

5.1: “Ake umemeze; ukhona okuphendulayo na? Uyakuphendukela kumuphi kwabangcwele na?
5.2: Ngokuba isiwula siyabulawa ngukukhathazeka, nomhawu uyachitha oyisiphukuphuku.
5.3: Mina ngibonile isiwula sigxilile, kepha ngaqalekisa indlu yaso ngokuzumayo.
5.4: Abantwana baso bakude nokusindiswa, bachotshozwa esangweni; akakho obophulayo,
5.5: abakuvuna kwabo kudliwa ngabalambileyo, bakukhipha nasemeveni; abanxanelayo basezela impahla yabo.
5.6: Ngokuba usizi aluveli othulini, nokuhlupheka akuphumi emhlabathini,
5.7: ngokuba umuntu uzalelwa ukuhlupheka, njengokuba izinhlansi ziqhashela phezulu.
5.8: “Kodwa mina bengiyakumfuna uNkulunkulu; kuNkulunkulu bengiyakubeka indaba yami,
5.9: yena owenza izinto ezinkulu ezingaphenyekiyo, izimangaliso ezingenakubalwa,
5.10: yena onisa imvula emhlabeni, athume amanzi ebusweni bamasimu,
5.11: ukuze aphakamise abayizimpofana nabadabukileyo baphakanyiselwe ukusindiswa.
5.12: Uyachitha amacebo abanobuqili, ukuze izandla zabo zingabi nakufeza umgomo wabo.
5.13: Uyabamba abahlakaniphileyo ebuqilini babo; isiluleko soyisigwegwe siyachithwa ngokuphuthuma.
5.14: Emini bahlangana nobumnyama, baphumputha emini njengasebusuku.
5.15: Uyasindisa enkembeni yemilomo yabo, yebo, abampofu esandleni sonamandla.
5.16: Ompofu usenethemba; ububi buvala umlomo wabo.
5.17: “Bheka, ubusisiwe lowo muntu uNkulunkulu amlayayo; ngalokho ungadeleli ukukhuzwa nguSomandla.
5.18: Ngokuba uma ezwisa ubuhlungu, ubuye abophe; uyalimaza, kepha izandla zakhe zibuye zelaphe.
5.19: Uyakophula ezinhluphekweni eziyisithupha; yebo, nakweziyisikhombisa awuyikuthintwa ngokubi.
5.20: Endlaleni uyakukuhlenga ekufeni nasempini emandleni enkemba.
5.21: Uyakufihlwa enkalivasini* yolimi; awuyikwesaba lapho kufika ukuchitha.
5.22: Uyakuhleka incithakalo nendlala, nezilo zomhlaba awuyikuzesaba.
5.23: Ngokuba unesivumelwano namatshe asendle; izilo zasendle zihlalisana kahle nawe.
5.24: Uyakwazi ukuthi itende lakho linokuthula; uyakuhambela indlu yakho, awuyikusilalelwa lutho.
5.25: Uyakwazi ukuthi inzalo yakho iyakuba nkulu, abantwana bakho babe njengotshani bomhlaba.
5.26: Uyakufika ethuneni usuthi ngobudala njengeqhinqa lamabele ngesikhathi salo.
5.27: Bheka, lokho sikuphenyile; kunjalo; kuzwe, uzazele khona.”

6.2: “Sengathi ukuncokolozwa kwami ngabe kulinganiswe nokulinganiswa, inhlupheko yami ibekwe esilinganisweni kanyekanye.
6.3: Ngokuba manje iyasinda kunesihlabathi solwandle; ngalokho amazwi ami ayengukubheda.
6.4: Ngokuba imicibisholo kaSomandla ikimi; isihlungu sayo siphuzwa ngumoya wami; izesabiso zikaNkulunkulu ziyangehlela.
6.5: Imbongolo yasendle iyakhala yini inotshani na? Inkabi iyakhonya isekudleni kwayo na?
6.6: Okudumayo kungadliwa ngaphandle kukasawoti na? Kukhona ukuklwabusa kokumhlophe kweqanda na?
6.7: Umphefumulo wami uyala ukukuthinta, kungukudla okunengekayo kimi.
6.8: “Sengathi isicelo sami singenziwa, uNkulunkulu angiphe lokhu engikubhekayo.
6.9: Yebo, sengathi uNkulunkulu angangichoboza, athukulule isandla sakhe, anginqume.
6.10: Lokho ngakube kuhlale kube yinduduzo yami, yebo, ngabe ngijabule ebuhlungwini obungahawukeliyo ukuthi angigodlanga amazwi oNgcwele.
6.11: Ayini amandla ami ukuba ngingaze ngethembe na? Ukuphela kwami kuyini ukuba ngingaze ngibekezele na?
6.12: Pho, amandla ami angamandla amatshe yini? Inyama yami iyithusi na?
6.13: Akusikho yini ukuthi alukho usizo kimi; ukusindiswa kususwa kimi.
6.14: “Odangeleyo nga ehawukelwa ngumngane wakhe; kepha ukumesaba uSomandla kuyayekwa.
6.15: Abafowethu bambuluzile njengomfula, njengemithonjana yemifula eshayo,
6.16: emnyama ngeqhwa, lapho ungqoqwane ezisitheza khona,
6.17: kepha ngesikhathi sokufudumala inyamalale, ishe endaweni yayo, lapho libalele.
6.18: Abahamba ngezindlela zayo bayaphambuka, benyukela oqwathuleni, babhubhe.
6.19: Izihambi zakwaThema zabheka; izindwendwe zakwaSheba zazihlalela.
6.20: Zajabha, ngokuba zazibhekile; sezifike khona zadana.
6.21: Ngokuba kalokhu seniyize nje; nibona okwesabisayo niyesaba.
6.22: Ngasho yini ukuthi: ‘Ngipheni, ninginike isipho empahleni yenu,’ na?
6.23: noma: ‘Ngikhululeni esandleni sesitha, ningihlenge esandleni sezidlova,’ na?
6.24: “Ngifundiseni, khona ngiyakuthula mina, ningiqondise lapho ngiduke khona.
6.25: Ukukhuluma okuqotho kunamandla, kepha ukusolwa nokusolwa yinina kusizani na?
6.26: Nicabanga yini ukusola amazwi, lokhu ukukhuluma kophelelwa ithemba kungumoya nje na?
6.27: Yebo, nenza inkatho ngentandane, nithengisa ngomngane wenu.
6.28: Manje, qalani ukungibuka; kuyakuba sobala, uma ngiqamba amanga.
6.29: Ake niphenduke, kungabikho ukungalungi, nibuye niphenduke; indaba yami ilungile.
6.30: Kukhona ukungalungi olimini lwami yini, ulwanga lwami alunakuqonda okubi na?

7.1: “Umuntu akasempini yini emhlabeni, imihla yakhe ayinjengemihla yomqashwa na?
7.2: Njengenceku ekhefuzelela ithunzi, nanjengomqashwa obheka umvuzo wakhe,
7.3: kanjalo ngithole ifa lezinyanga zokubi; ngimiselwe ubusuku bezinhlupheko.
7.4: Lapho ngilala phansi, ngisho ngithi: ‘Ngingavuka nini,’ ngokuba ubusuku bude; ngigcwele ukubinyabinyeka kuze kuse.
7.5: Inyama yami yembesiwe izimpethu namagade othuli; isikhumba sami siyaphola, sibuye sibhicike.
7.7: Khumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwami kungumoya; iso lami aliyikubuye libone okuhle.
7.8: Iso longibonayo alisayikungibuka; amehlo akho esekimi, angisekho.
7.9: Ifu liphela lihamba; kanjalo owehlele endaweni yabafileyo akasayikukhuphuka.
7.10: Kasayikubuyela endlini yakhe; indawo yakhe ayisayikumazi.
7.11: “Ngalokho nami angiyikubamba umlomo wami; ngiyakukhuluma osizini lomoya wami, ngikhale ngomunyu womphefumulo wami.
7.12: Ngilulwandle yini, ngingumkhomo yini, ukuze ungibekele abalindi?
7.13: Lapho ngithi umbhede wami uyakungiduduza, ukhukho lwami lungithwalise ukukhala kwami,
7.15: ukuze umphefumulo wami ukhethe ukuklinywa nokufa kunalawa mathambo ami.
7.16: Ngiyanengwa yiwo; mangingahlali njalo; ngiyeke, ngokuba imihla yami iyize.
7.17: Uyini umuntu ukuba umkhulise, nokuba ubeke inhliziyo yakho kuye,
7.18: nokuba umhambele ekuseni njalo, umhlole njalonjalo, na?
7.19: Koze kube nini uyeka ukungibheka na? Ngiyeke, ngize ngiminze amathe ami.
7.20: Noma ngonile, ngenzeni kuwe mlindi wabantu na? Ungimiseleni ngibe yisigcibisholo sakho, ngize ngibe ngumthwalo nakimi, na?
7.21: Awuthetheleli ngani isiphambeko sami, ususe isono sami, na? Ngokuba manje ngiyakulala phansi othulini; uyakungifunisisa, kepha angiyikubakho.”

8.2: “Koze kube nini ukhuluma lezi zinto, amazwi akho abe ngumoya onamandla, na?
8.3: UNkulunkulu uhlanekezela ukwahlulela yini? USomandla uphendukezela ukulunga na?
8.4: Uma abantwana bakho bonile kuye, yena wabanikela emandleni ezono zabo,
8.5: khona, uma wena ufunisisa uNkulunkulu, unxuse kuye uSomandla,
8.6: uma uhlambulukile, futhi ulungile, khona yena uyakuvuka ngenxa yakho, aphumelelise ikhaya lokulunga kwakho.
8.7: Ukuqala kwakho sekuyakuba ngokuncane, nokugcina kwakho kube ngokukhulu kakhulu.
8.8: Ake ubuze ezizukulwaneni zakuqala, uzibhekise lokho abakuphenyileyo oyise bazo,
8.9: ngokuba thina singabezolo nje, asinalwazi, lokhu imihla yethu emhlabeni iyithunzi;
8.10: bona abayikukufundisa yini, bakutshele, bakhiphe amazwi ezinhliziyweni zabo, na?
8.11: Umhlanga ungahluma lapho kungekho xhaphozi na? Incema ingamila kungekho manzi na?
8.12: Uma iseluhlaza, ingakakhiwa, iyabuna phambi kwabo bonke utshani.
8.13: “Zinjalo izindlela zabo bonke abakhohlwa uNkulunkulu: ithemba longenaNkulunkulu liyakuchitheka;
8.14: ithemba lakhe liyakunqunywa, nesisekelo sakhe siyindlu yolwembu.
8.15: Uyakwencika endlini yakhe, kepha ayiyikuma; uyakubambelela kuyo, kepha ayiyikuqina.
8.16: Yena uluhlaza phambi kwelanga; imixhantela yakhe iyaxhantela ensimini yakhe.
8.17: Izimpande zakhe ziyathandela enqwabeni yamatshe, aqhekeze indawo yamatshe.
8.18: Uma echithwa endaweni yakhe, iyakumala ngokuthi: ‘Angizange ngikubone.’
8.19: Bheka, injalo indlela yokuthokoza kwakhe; kuyakuvela abanye othulini.
8.21: aze agcwalise umlomo wakho ngokuhleka, nezindebe zakho ngokumemeza.
8.22: Abakuzondayo bayakwembeswa amahloni; itende lababi aliyobe lisabakho.”

9.2: “Ngeqiniso ngiyazi ukuthi kunjalo, kepha umuntu angaba elungile phambi kukaNkulunkulu na?
9.3: Uma efuna ukuthetha amacala naye, angemphendule nakwelilodwa kwayinkulungwane.
9.4: Ehlakaniphile enhliziyweni, eqinile emandleni, ngubani oziqinisele kuye, waphumelela,
9.5: yena ogudluza izintaba ngokungazeleli, ezigumbuqela ngentukuthelo yakhe;
9.6: ozamazamisa umhlaba usuke endaweni yawo, kuthuthumele izinsika zawo;
9.8: oweneka izulu yedwa, ahambe emazeni olwandle;
9.9: owenza iBhere,* neMpambano, nesiLimela, namaKamelo aseningizimu;*
9.10: owenza izinto ezinkulu ezingenakuhlolwa, yebo, izimangaliso ezingenakubalwa.
9.12: Bheka, uyabamba; ngubani ongamkhalima na? Ngubani ongasho kuye ukuthi: ‘Wenzani na?’
9.13: “UNkulunkulu akayikubuyisa intukuthelo yakhe; phansi kwakhe bayakhothama abasizi bakaRahabi.
9.14: Pho, mina ngingamphendula ngithini, ngikhethe amazwi ami aqondene naye, na?
9.15: Noma bengilungile, bengingenakumphendula, kepha nginxuse umahluleli wami.
9.16: Uma bengimbizile abesengiphendula, bengingayikukholwa nokho ukuthi ubekile indlebe ezwini lami.
9.17: Uyangilimaza ngesiphepho; uyandisa amanxeba ami ngeze.
9.18: Kavumi ukuba ngiphefumule, kepha uyangigcwalisa ngomunyu.
9.19: Uma kuyindaba yamandla, nangu onawo; uma yindaba yokwahlulela, ngubani ongimemayo na?
9.20: Noma ngilungile, umlomo wami uyakungilahla; noma ngingenacala, uyakuthi ngonakele.
9.21: Anginasici; anginakekeli umphefumulo wami; anginanzi ukuphila kwami.
9.22: Ukuphela kunye nje; ngalokho ngithi: ‘Uyaqeda ongenasici kanye nomubi.’
9.23: Uma isiswebhu sibulala ngokuzumayo, uyahleka ingozi yabangenacala.
9.24: Umhlaba unikezwe esandleni sababi; uyasibekela ubuso babahluleli bawo; uma kungesiye, pho, ngubani na?
9.25: “Imihla yami iyashesha kunesigijimi; iyabaleka ingabonanga okuhle.
9.26: Itshuza njengomkhunjana womhlanga, njengokhozi olutheleka empangweni.
9.27: Noma ngithi ngiyakukhohlwa ukukhala kwami, ngiyeke ukunyukubala kwami, ngincibilike,
9.28: ngiyesaba nokho bonke ubuhlungu bami, ngiyazi ukuthi awuyikungibheka nginjengongenacala.
9.30: Noma ngizigeza ngamanzi eqhwa, ngihlambe izandla zami ngensipho,
9.31: uyakungicwilisa nokho emgodini, izingubo zami zinengwe yimi.
9.32: Ngokuba akasiye umuntu onjengami ukuba ngingase ngimphendule, siye kanyekanye ekwahlulelweni.
9.33: Akukho mnqamulajuqu phakathi kwethu ongabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwethu sobabili.
9.34: Makayisuse induku yakhe kimi; ingebhe ngaye mayingangesabisi.
9.35: Khona ngiyakukhuluma, ngingamesabi, ngokuba anginjalo ngokwami.

10.1: “Umphefumulo wami ukhathele ukuhamba kwami; ngiyazinikela ekukhaleni, ngikhulume ngomunyu womphefumulo wami.
10.2: Ngiyakusho kuNkulunkulu ukuthi: ‘Ungangilahli; ngazise ukuthi uphikisanelani nami na?
10.3: Kuhle yini kuwe ukuba ucindezele, ulahle umsebenzi wezandla zakho, ukhanye phezu kwamasu ababi, na?
10.4: Amehlo enyama unawo na? Uyabona njengabantu na?
10.5: Imihla yakho injengemihla yomuntu na? Neminyaka yakho injengezinsuku zabantu na?
10.6: lokhu ufuna ukona kimi, ufunisisa isono sami,
10.7: noma ukwazi ukuthi angimubi nokuthi akakho ongophula esandleni sakho.
10.8: Izandla zakho zingibumbile, zangenza ngokupheleleyo nxazonke; nokho uyangichitha.
10.9: Ake ukhumbule ukuthi ungenzile njengebumba; pho, uyakungibuyisela othulini na?
10.11: Awungembathisanga isikhumba nenyama, wangiphica ngamathambo nangemisipha, na?
10.12: Ungenzele ukuphila nomusa; ukungihambela kwakho kulondile umoya wami.
10.13: Kepha ufihlile enhliziyweni yakho lokhu; ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kukuwe kokuthi:
10.14: Uma ngona, uyangiqaphela; awuyikuthethelela ukona kwami.
10.15: Uma nginecala, maye kimi! Noma bengilungile, bengingayikuphakamisa ikhanda lami, lokhu ngisuthi ngehlazo, ngibona ukuhlupheka kwami.
10.16: Nokuba bengiziphakamisa, ubuyakungizingela njengengonyama, ubuye uzenze omangalisayo kimi.
10.17: Ubuyakuletha kimi ofakazi abasha, wandise intukuthelo yakho kimi, amabandla ngamabandla angisukele.
10.19: ngibe njengokungathi ngingekho, ngiyiswe ethuneni ngisaphuma esiswini.
10.20: Imihla yami ayiyingcosana na? Makapheze, angiyeke ukuba ngithokoze kancane,
10.21: ngingakayi lapho ngingasayikubuya khona, izwe lobumnyama nelomthunzi wokufa,
10.22: izwe lobumnyama obunjengesigayegaye nelomthunzi wokufa nelesiphithiphithi, lapho ukukhanya kunjengobumnyama.’ ”

11.2: “Awayikuphendulwa amazwi amaningi kangaka na? Umuntu oliphoshophosho angathethelelwa na?
11.3: Ukugavuza kwakho kuthulisa abantu na? Nalapho ukloloda, akakho ongakuhlaza na?
11.4: Ngokuba uthi: ‘Ukufundisa kwami kulungile; ngimhlophe emehlweni akho.’
11.5: Sengathi uNkulunkulu angakhuluma, akuvulele izindebe zakhe,
11.6: akwazise izimfihlakalo zokuhlakanipha, ngokuba ukuqonda kwakhe kuninginingi, uze wazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu, ukuba kube kuhle kuwe, wenza ukuba ikhohlakale inxenye yecala lakho.
11.7: “Ungathola imfihlakalo kaNkulunkulu na? Ungamfumana uSomandla kuze kube sekupheleleni kwakhe na?
11.8: Kuphakeme njengezulu – ungenzani na? Kujulile kunendawo yabafileyo – ungazini na?
11.9: Isilinganiso sakho side kunomhlaba, sibanzi kunolwandle.
11.10: Uma edlula, avalele, abizele ekwahluleleni, ngubani ongamkhalima na?
11.11: Ngokuba uyabazi abantu ababi; lapho ebona ukona, akayikukunaka na?
11.12: Umuntu oyize uyakuba nengqondo, nxa ithole lembongolo yasendle lizalwa libe ngumuntu.
11.13: “Uma ulungisa inhliziyo yakho, welulele izandla zakho kuye;
11.14: uma udedisele kude ukona okusesandleni sakho, ungahlalisi ububi ematendeni akho,
11.15: khona uyakuphakamisa ubuso bakho ungenamahloni, uqine, ungesabi.
11.16: Ngokuba uyakukhohlwa ukuhlupheka kwakho, ukukhumbule kunjengamanzi adlulileyo.
11.17: Ukuphila kwakho kuyakusa kunemini; noma kuhlwa, kuyakuba njengokusa nje.
11.18: Uyakuba nokwethemba, ngokuba ithemba likhona; uyakuphendla, ulale ngokulondeka.
11.19: Uyakulala, ungethuswa muntu; abaningi bayakuzincengela kuwe.
11.20: Kepha amehlo ababi ayakufiphala; abayikuba nandawo yokuphephela; ithemba labo liyakuba ngukuphuma komphefumulo.”

12.3: Kodwa nami nginengqondo njengani, angahlulwa yinina; ngubani ongazazi izinto ezinje na?
12.4: Ngiyisigcono somngane wami, ngowambiza uNkulunkulu, waphendula; olungileyo nongenasici uyisigcono.
12.5: Emcabangweni wohlezi kahle ingozi iyadeleleka; kulungiselwe abazinyawo zabo zishelela.
12.6: Amatende abacindezelayo anokuthula; abathukuthelisayo uNkulunkulu bayalondeka, abaletha unkulunkulu wabo ngezandla zabo.
12.7: Kepha mawubuze izinkomo, ziyakukufundisa, nezinyoni zezulu, ziyakukutshela.
12.8: Khuluma kuwo umhlaba, uyakukufundisa, nezinhlanzi zolwandle ziyakukulandisa.
12.9: Ngubani ongaziyo ngakho konke lokho ukuthi isandla sikaJehova sikwenzile lokho na?
12.10: Esandleni sakhe ukhona umphefumulo wakho konke okuphilayo, nomoya wenyama yabantu bonke.
12.11: Indlebe ayivivinyi yini amazwi, njengolwanga lunambitha ukudla, na?
12.12: Ezimpungeni kukhona ukuhlakanipha, nasebudeni bezinsuku ukuqonda.
12.14: Bheka, uyadiliza, kungabe kusakhiwa; uyavalela umuntu, kungabe kusavulwa.
12.15: Bheka, uyavimba amanzi, ashe; uyawathumela agumbuqele umhlaba.
12.16: Kuye kukhona amandla nokusizwa; odukisiweyo nodukileyo bakuye.
12.17: Umukisa abaluleki bephangiwe; uyenza abahluleli babe yiziwula.
12.18: Uthukulula izibopho zamakhosi, awabophe ezinkalweni ngamaketanga.
12.19: Umukisa abapristi bephangiwe, aphenule abemiyo njalo.
12.20: Uyasusa ulimi lwabathembekileyo, aphuce amalunga ukuqonda.
12.21: Uthela izikhulu ngehlazo, akhumule imbonya yonamandla.
12.22: Uyambula izinto ezijulileyo ebumnyameni, akhiphele ekukhanyeni ithunzi lokufa.
12.23: Uyandisa izizwe, abesezibhubhisa; ukhulisa izizwe, abesezisusa.
12.24: Uyamuka izinhloko zezizwe ezweni ingqondo yazo, azidukise ehlane elingenandlela.

13.1: “Bheka, iso lami libone konke; indlebe yami ikuzwile, yakuqonda.
13.3: Kepha ngiyakukhuluma kuSomandla; ngifuna ukuphikisana noNkulunkulu.
13.5: Sengathi ningathula nokuthula, lokho kube ngukuhlakanipha kini.
13.6: Ake nizwe ukuthetha kwami, niqaphele ukuzivikela kwezindebe zami.
13.7: Niyakumkhulumela uNkulunkulu ngokubi, nimkhulumele ngenkohliso, na?
13.8: Niyakubuvuma ubuso bakhe, nimmele uNkulunkulu, na?
13.9: Kuhle yini, lapho eniphendla? Njengalokhu umuntu ekhohliswa niyakumkhohlisa na?
13.10: Uyakunisola nokunisola, uma nivuna ubuso ngasese.
13.11: Ubukhulu bakhe abuyikunethusa, nengebhe ngaye inehlele, na?
13.12: Izikhumbuzo zenu ziyizaga zomlotha; izivikelo zenu ziyizivikelo zebumba.
13.13: “Thulani, ningiyeke ukuba ngikhulume, kungehlele noma yini.
13.14: Bengiyakuyithathelani inyama yami ngamazinyo ami, ngibeke ukuphila kwami esandleni sami, na?
13.15: Bheka, uyakungibulala, anginathemba; nokho ngiyakuvikela izindlela zami ebusweni bakhe.
13.16: Lokhu kuyakuba yinsindiso yami ukuthi ongenaNkulunkulu akezi phambi kwakhe.
13.17: Zwisisani amazwi ami, ukusho kwami kube sezindlebeni zenu.
13.18: Bhekani-ke, sengilungisile ukwahlulelwa kwami; ngiyazi ukuthi ngiyakuthethwa mina.
13.19: Ngubani oyakuphikisana nami na? Ngokuba lapho bengiyakuthula, ngigqabuke.
13.20: Izinto ezimbili kuphela ungazenzi kimi, ngize ngingacasheli ubuso bakho:
13.21: masingasondeli kimi isandla sakho, ngingethuswa yingebhe ngawe.
13.22: Khona mawubize, mina ngiyakuphendula, noma kukhulume mina, wena ungiphendule.
13.23: Iziphambeko zami nezono zami zingakanani na? Ngazise izeqo zami nezono zami.
13.24: Usithelani ubuso bakho, ungishaye isitha, na?
13.25: Uyakwethusa iqabunga eliphephethwayo, uxoshe amabibi awomileyo, na?
13.26: Ngokuba uloba okumunyu ngami, ungidlisa ifa lobubi bobusha bami;
13.27: ufaka izinyawo zami ezingongolweni, uqaphela zonke izindlela zami, uzidwebela umudwa ngasematheni ezinyawo zami,
13.28: noma nginyamalala njengokubolayo, njengengubo edliwe yizinundu.

14.1: “Umuntu ozelwe ngowesifazane imihla yakhe mifushane, igcwele ukuyaluza.
14.2: Uyavela njengembali, abune; ubaleka njengethunzi, angemi.
14.3: Konje uvulela onjalo amehlo akho, ungingenise ekwahluleweni nawe, na?
14.4: Ngubani ongaveza okuhlambulukileyo kukho okungcolileyo na? Kakho noyedwa.
14.5: Uma imihla yakhe inqunyiwe, umumo wezinsuku zakhe ukuwe, ubekile umkhawulo wakhe, aze angadluli,
14.6: ungambheki, aphumule, ukuze athokoze ngosuku lwakhe njengomqashwa.
14.7: “Ngokuba kukhona ithemba emthini: uma unqunywa, ungabuye uhlume, nehlumela lawo aliyikuphela.
14.8: Noma impande yawo iguga emhlabathini, nesiphunzi sawo sifela othulini,
14.9: ngephunga lamanzi uyakuhluma, uveze izingatsha njengesithombo.
14.10: Kepha umuntu ofileyo uphelile; umuntu ogqabukileyo uphi na?
14.11: Njengamanzi anyamalele elwandle, nomfula oshileyo ome,
14.12: kanjalo umuntu ulala phansi, angabe esavuka; lize lingabikho izulu abayikuvuka, bangaphaphanyiswa ebuthongweni babo.
14.13: Sengathi ungangifihla endaweni yabafileyo, ungisithe kuze kudlule intukuthelo yakho, unginqumele isikhathi, ungikhumbule.
14.14: Uma umuntu efa, uyakubuye aphile na? Bengiyakulinda zonke izinsuku zomshikashika wami, kuze kufike ukumuka kwami.
14.15: Ubuyakubiza, mina ngiphendule; ubuyakulangazelela umsebenzi wezandla zakho,
14.16: yebo, khona ubuyakubala izinyathelo zami, ungaqapheli isono sami.
14.17: Isiphambeko besiyakuvalelwa esikhwameni, besewusibekela ukona kwami.
14.18: “Impela intaba iyawa, idilike; idwala liyasuswa endaweni yalo;
14.19: amanzi ayagubha amatshe; ukuphuphuma kwawo kuyakhukhula uthuli lomhlaba; kanjalo uyachitha nethemba lomuntu.
14.20: Uyamsukela kuze kube phakade, amuke; uyaguqula ubuso bakhe, ummukise.
14.21: Amadodana akhe ayadunyiswa, engazi yena; ayeyiswa, engakuqondi.
14.22: Inyama yakhe iyezwa ubuhlungu bayo kuphela; umphefumulo wakhe uzidabukela wona kuphela.”

15.2: “Ohlakaniphileyo uyakuphendula ngokwazi okungumoya nje, agcwalise isisu ngomoya wasempumalanga, na?
15.3: Aphikisane ngamazwi angasizi lutho nangezinkulumo ezingenalusizo na?
15.4: Yebo, uyachitha ukwesaba, unciphisa ukuzindla phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
15.5: Ngokuba ububi bakho buyafundisa umlomo wakho; ukhetha ulimi lwabanobuqili.
15.6: Ngumlomo wakho okulahlayo, akusimi; izindebe zakho ziyafakaza ngawe.
15.7: Ungumuntu wokuqala owazalwayo na? Wavela ngaphambi kwezintaba na?
15.8: Uzwile imfihlakalo kaNkulunkulu, wazigodlela wedwa ukuhlakanipha na?
15.9: Wazini esingayazi thina na? Uqonda ntoni engekho kithina na?
15.10: Kithina kukhona izimpunga namakhehla amadala kunoyihlo.
15.11: Zincane yini kuwe izinduduzo zikaNkulunkulu, nezwi elikhulunywa kahle kuwe na?
15.12: Umukiselwani yinhliziyo yakho na? Kungani ukuba amehlo akho aphayizele,
15.13: uphendulele kuNkulunkulu ukufutheka kwakho, ukhiphe amazwi emlonyeni wakho na?
15.14: Uyini umuntu ukuba abe ngohlambulukileyo, nozelwe ngowesifazane ukuba alungisiswe, na?
15.15: Bheka, nabangcwele bakhe akabethembi, nezulu alihlambulukile emehlweni akhe;
15.16: kakhulu kangakanani onengekayo nowonakeleyo, umuntu ophuza ukona njengamanzi, na?
15.18: lokho izihlakaniphi ezikubonakalisile, zikuthathe koyise, zingakufihlanga,
15.19: zona ezaphiwa zodwa izwe, kungadabulanga kuzo umfokazi ngokuthi:
15.20: Umuntu omubi uyazibinya imihla yonke, umumo weminyaka othukuselwe isidlwangudlwangu.
15.21: Izwi lengebhe lisezindlebeni zakhe; lapho ehlezi kahle, uyakufikelwa ngumphangi.
15.22: Akethembi ukuthi uyakubuya ebumnyameni; uyalindelwa yinkemba.
15.23: Uyazulazulela ukudla: kuphi na? Uyazi ukuthi usuku lobumnyama selungasesandleni sakhe.
15.24: Ukuhlupheka nosizi kuyamethusa; kuyamahlula njengenkosi ezilungiselele impi,
15.25: ngokuba waselulela isandla sakhe kuNkulunkulu, wazigabisa kuSomandla.
15.26: Wamdumela ngentamo elukhuni, nangamaqhubu adumbileyo amahawu akhe,
15.27: ngokuba wasibekela ubuso bakhe ngamafutha akhe, wenza umvingqi okhalweni lwakhe.
15.28: Wahlala emizini ebiyakuchithwa, nasezindlini ebezingahlalwa, ezaziyakuba ngamanxiwa nje.
15.29: Akayikuceba, nemfuyo yakhe ayiyikuma, nokudla kwakhe akuyikukhothamela phansi.
15.30: Akayikusuka ebumnyameni; ilangabi liyakushisa amagatsha akhe, amuke ngokuphefumula komlomo kaNkulunkulu.
15.31: Makangethembi ezeni, ezikhohlisa, ngokuba ize liyakuba ngumvuzo wakhe.
15.32: Kuyakufezwa kungakabi yisikhathi, negatsha lakhe alisayikuba luhlaza.
15.33: Uyakuvuthulula igwanya lakhe njengomvini, alahle imbali yakhe njengomnqumo.
15.34: Ngokuba ibandla labangenaNkulunkulu liyakuba yinyumba, umlilo uqede amatende abathengwa ngemivuzo.
15.35: Bakhulelwe ingozi, bazala ukona; isisu sabo silungisela inkohliso.”

16.2: “Ngizwile izinto eziningi ezinjalo; nina nonke ningabaduduzi ababi.
16.3: Amazwi angumoya nje awayikuphela yini? Ucunulwa yintoni ukuba uphendule na?
16.4: Nami ngingakhuluma njengani; uma imiphefumulo yenu ibisesikhundleni somphefumulo wami, bengiyakuhlanganisa amazwi ngani, ngininikinele ikhanda lami.
16.5: Benginganiqinisa ngomlomo, induduzo yezindebe zami inidambise.
16.6: “Noma ngikhuluma, ubuhlungu bami abudanjiswanga; noma ngiyeka, kuyini okumuka kimi na?
16.7: Kepha manje ungikhathazile, uyichithile yonke indlu yami.
16.8: Ungicindezele, kungubufakazi; ukonda kwami kuyangivukela, kufakaze ebusweni bami.
16.9: Ulaka lwakhe luyangidwengula, lungizingele; uyangigedlela amazinyo; isitha sami singicijisela amehlo aso.
16.10: Bangikhamisela imilomo yabo, bangimukula esihlathini ngenhlamba, bangihlanganyela.
16.11: UNkulunkulu uyanginikela kubantu abonakeleyo, angiphonse esandleni sababi.
16.12: Ngangihlezi kahle, wangichoboza; wangibamba ngentamo, wangiphahlaza; wangimisa ngibe yisigcibisholo.
16.13: Abacibishelayo bakhe bangihaqa; uyaqhekeza izinso zami engenasihawu; uchithela inyongo yami emhlabathini.
16.15: “Ngithungile indwangu yamasaka phezu kwesikhumba sami. ngingcolisile uphondo lwami othulini.
16.16: Ubuso bami bubomvu ngokukhala; ezinkosheni zami kukhona ithunzi lokufa,
16.17: noma kungekho ubudlova ezandleni zami nokukhuleka kwami kulungile.
16.18: Mhlaba, ungathukusi igazi lami; ukukhala kwami makungabi nandawo.
16.19: Namanje bheka, ufakazi wami usezulwini; ummeli wami usezindaweni eziphakemeyo.
16.20: Abangane bami bayangiklolodela; iso lami liphophoza izinyembezi kuNkulunkulu
16.21: ukuba amphikele umuntu kuNkulunkulu nendodana yomuntu kumakhelwane wayo.
16.22: Ngokuba iyingcosana iminyaka eyakubalwa, ngingakahambi indlela engingayikubuya kuyo.

17.1: “Umoya wami usuchithekile, imihla yami iyacimeka; okwami sekuyithuna nje.
17.2: Impela kukhona abangiklolodelayo, iso lami lisekucunuleni kwabo.
17.3: Ake unginike isibambiso, ungimele; ngubani oyakuxhawulana nami na?
17.4: Ngokuba uvalile izinhliziyo zabo zingaqondi; ngalokho awuyikubaphakamisa.
17.5: Ochaka abangane bakhe ngenxa yesabelo, amehlo abantwana bakhe ayakufiphala.
17.6: Ungibeke isaga sabantu, ngibe ngokhafulelwa ebusweni.
17.7: Iso lami lifiphele ngosizi; onke amalungu ami anjengethunzi.
17.8: Abaqotho bayethuswa yilokho; ongenacala uyavukela ongenaNkulunkulu.
17.9: Kepha olungileyo ubambelela endleleni yakhe; onezandla ezihlanzekileyo ude eqina njalo.
17.10: Nokho buyani nonke phela, nize; kodwa angiyikuthola phakathi kwenu ohlakaniphileyo.
17.11: Imihla yami isidlulile, amasu ami anqunyiwe kanye nemicabango yami yenhliziyo.
17.12: Ubusuku babenza imini, bathi: ‘Ukukhanya kuseduze nobumnyama.’
17.13: Uma ngithemba ukuthi indawo yabafileyo iyindlu yami, ngendlalele ukhukho lwami ebumnyameni,
17.14: ngibize ukubola ngokuthi ubaba nezimpethu ngokuthi umame nodadewethu,
17.15: liphi, pho, ithemba lami na? Yebo, ithemba lami, ngubani oyakulibona na?
17.16: Liyakwehlela emigoqweni yendawo yabafileyo, lapho kuyakuba khona ukuphumula othulini kanyekanye.”

18.2: “Koze kube nini nibekela amazwi ami izingibe na? Qondani, andukuba sikhulume.
18.3: Kungani ukuba sithiwe siyizilwane, singcolile emehlweni enu, na?
18.4: Wena ozidwengula olakeni lwakho, umhlaba uyakushiywa ngenxa yakho, nedwala lisuswe endaweni yalo, na?
18.5: Yebo, nokukhanya komubi kuyakucimeka, nelangabi lomlilo wakhe aliyikukhanya.
18.6: Ukukhanya kuyakufiphala etendeni lakhe, nesibani sakhe phezu kwakhe siyakucimeka.
18.7: Izinyathelo zakhe ezinamandla ziyakufinyezwa; amasu akhe ayamlahla phansi.
18.8: Ngokuba uyaphonswa yizinyawo zakhe enetheni, uhamba phezu kweveku.
18.11: Ingebhe iyakumethusa nxazonke; iyamzingela ezinyathelweni zakhe.
18.12: Ububi buyakumlambela, ulungiselwe ingozi eceleni kwakhe.
18.13: Amalungu omzimba wakhe ayakudliwa, yebo, ukufa okwesabekayo kuyakudla amalungu akhe.
18.14: Uyakuhlwithwa etendeni lakhe alethembayo, ayiswe enkosini yengebhe.
18.15: Etendeni lakhe bayakuhlala abangesibo abakhe, kuvumvuzelwe isibabule ekhaya lakhe.
18.16: Izimpande zakhe ziyakoma ngaphansi; phezulu kuyabuna amagatsha akhe.
18.17: Ukukhunjulwa kwakhe kuyakuphela emhlabeni, angabi negama ezweni.
18.18: Uyakukhishwa ekukhanyeni, aqhutshelwe ebumnyameni, axoshwe ezweni.
18.19: Akayikuba nandodana namzukulwana phakathi kwabantu bakhe; akuyikuba khona lapho egogobala khona.
18.20: Abasentshonalanga bayethuswa lusuku lwakhe, nabasempumalanga babanjwa ngukwesaba.
18.21: Impela zinjalo izindlu zaboni; injalo indawo engamazi uNkulunkulu.”

19.2: “Koze kube nini nihlupha umphefumulo wami, ningiphohloze ngamazwi, na?
19.3: Seningihlazisile kayishumi; aninamahloni okuthi ningiphathe kabi na?
19.4: Uma impela ngidukile, ukuduka kwami kukimi ngedwa.
19.5: Uma impela niyazikhukhumezela kimi, niphikisane nami ngehlazo lami,
19.6: yazini-ke ukuthi uNkulunkulu ungihlanekezele, ungihaqe ngenetha.
19.7: Bheka, ngikhala ngithi: ‘Ngubudlova!’ Kepha angiphendulwa; ngicela ukusizwa, kodwa akukho ukwahlulelwa.
19.8: Uvalile indlela yami ukuze ngingabi nakudlula; ubeka ubumnyama emikhondweni yami.
19.9: Ungikhumulile udumo lwami; ususile umqhele ekhanda lami.
19.10: Ungidilizile nxazonke, sengimukile; usiphulile ithemba lami njengomuthi.
19.11: Ungivuthisele intukuthelo yakhe, wangishaya njengezitha kuye.
19.12: Amabutho akhe afika kanyekanye, alungise indlela ukuba angisukele; amisa nxazonke zetende lami.
19.13: “Udedisile kimi abafowethu, nabazana nami sebahlukene impela nami.
19.14: Izihlobo zami zingishiyile, nengazana nabo bangikhohliwe.
19.15: Abagogobele endlini yami nezincekukazi zami bangishaya umfokazi; ngingowezizwe emehlweni abo.
19.16: Ngibiza inceku yami, kayingiphenduli; ngiyayinxusa ngomlomo wami.
19.17: Umoya wami mubi kumkami, ngiyanuka kubantwana besisu sikamame.
19.18: Yebo, nezingane ziyangidelela; uma ngivuka, zikhuluma ngami.
19.19: Ababeyizifuba zami bayanengwa yimi; labo ababengithanda sebengifulathele.
19.20: Amathambo ami anamathela esikhumbeni sami nasenyameni yami; ngisinde ngokulambisa kuphela.
19.21: Ngihawukeleni, ngihawukeleni, nina bangane bami, ngokuba isandla sikaNkulunkulu singithintile.
19.22: Ningizingelelani njengoNkulunkulu, ningasuthi ngenyama yami na?
19.23: “Sengathi amazwi ami angalotshwa! Sengathi angabhalwa encwadini,
19.24: aqoshwe edwaleni ngepeni lensimbi nangomthofu, kuze kube phakade!
19.25: Kepha mina ngiyazi ukuthi uMhlengi wami ukhona; ekupheleni uyakuma othulini.
19.26: Nalapho sesishabalele isikhumba sami, ngiyakumbuka uNkulunkulu ngikhululekile enyameni yami,
19.27: engiyakumbona uqobo lwami; amehlo ami ayakumbona, kungabi njengomfokazi; okuphakathi kwami kuyaphela esifubeni sami.
19.28: Uma nithi: ‘Siyakumxosha yini pho! njengokuba impande yendaba ifumaniseka kimi,’
19.29: yesabani inkemba, ngokuba ulaka lungolwezono ezifanele inkemba, ukuze nazi ukuthi ukwahlulelwa kukhona.”

20.2: “Ngalokho imicabango yami iyangiphendula ngenxa yokushesha okuphakathi kwami.
20.3: Ngiyezwa insolo engihlazisayo, kepha umoya wasengqondweni yami uyangiphendula.
20.4: “Awukwazi yini ukuba lokhu kungokwasendulo, selokhu abantu babekwa emhlabeni,
20.5: ukuthi ukujabula kwababi kufushane, nokuthokoza kwabangenaNkulunkulu kungokokuphazima kweso nje, na?
20.6: Noma ubukhulu bakhe bukhuphukela ezulwini, nekhanda lakhe lifinyelela emafwini,
20.7: uyakubhubha kuze kube phakade njengamasimba akhe; abambonayo bayakuthi: ‘Uphi na?’
20.8: Uyakundiza njengephupho, angabe esafunyanwa; uyakuxoshwa njengombono wasebusuku.
20.9: Iso elalimgqolozela alisamboni, nendawo yakhe ayisamboni.
20.10: Abantwana bakhe bayakuzincengela kwabampofu, izandla zakhe zibuyise impahla yakhe.
20.11: Amathambo akhe agcwele ubusha, kepha buyakulala phansi kanye naye othulini.
20.12: “Noma ububi bumnandi emlonyeni wakhe, noma ebufihla phansi kolimi lwakhe,
20.13: noma ebugodla engabushiyi, kepha ebugcina emlonyeni wakhe,
20.14: kuyaguquka nokho ukudla kwakhe phakathi kwakhe, kube yinyongo yamabululu ezibilinini zakhe.
20.15: Ugwinyile ingcebo; uyakubuye ayihlanze; uNkulunkulu uyakuyikhipha esiswini sakhe.
20.16: Uyakumunca isihlungu samabululu; ulimi lwenyoka luyakumbulala.
20.17: Akayikubuka imifula, iminonjana nemifudlana yezinyosi namangqanga.
20.18: Lokho owakukhandlekelayo uyakukubuyisa, angakugwinyi; ngempahla ayitholileyo akayikujabula.
20.19: Ngokuba ucindezele, washiya abampofu; uhlwithile indlu, angabuye ayakhe.
20.20: “Ngokuba wayengazi ukuthula esiswini sakhe; kayikuphepha nalutho kulokho akufisayo.
20.21: Akusalanga lutho angaludlanga; ngalokho inhlanhla yakhe ayiyikuma.
20.22: Ekusutheni kokuvama kwakhe uyaminywa; izandla zakho konke ukuhlupheka ziyakumfikela.
20.23: Kuyakuthi lapho eyakugcwalisa isisu sakhe, uNkulunkulu aphonse kuye ukuvutha kwentukuthelo yakhe, akunise phezu kwakhe esekudleni.
20.24: Uyabalekela isikhali sensimbi, kepha ubhotshozwa ngumnsalo wethusi.
20.25: Uyawukhipha uphume emzimbeni wakhe; nxa uphuma unyampuza enyongweni, abesehlelwa yingebhe.
20.26: Ubumnyama bonke bubekelelwe ingcebo yakhe; umlilo ongavuthelwanga uyakuyidla, uchithe okusele etendeni lakhe.
20.27: Izulu liyakwambula ububi bakhe, umhlaba umvukele.
20.28: Imfuyo yendlu yakhe iyakumuka, inyamalale ngomuhla wentukuthelo.
20.29: Lesi siyisabelo somuntu omubi esivela kuNkulunkulu, nefa alinqunyelweyo nguNkulunkulu.”

21.2: “Yizwani nokuzwa amazwi ami; lokhu makube yinduduzo evela kini.
21.3: Ngivumeleni ukuba nami ngikhulume; nalapho sengikhulumile, klolodani.
21.4: “Mina-ke, ukukhala kwami kungomuntu na? Ngingekhathazeke na?
21.5: Ngibukeni, nimangale, nibeke izandla emilonyeni yenu.
21.6: Lapho ngikhumbula nje, ngishaywa luvalo; ukwesaba kubamba inyama yami.
21.7: Ababi baphilelani, baze babe badala, yebo, bakhule emandleni, na?
21.8: Inzalo yabo iyema phambi kwabo kanye nabo, nabantwana babo phambi kwamehlo abo.
21.9: Izindlu zabo zinokuthula, azinangebhe; uswazi lukaNkulunkulu aluphezu kwabo.
21.10: Inkunzi yabo iyakhwela, kayiphuthi; inkomo yabo iyazala, kayiphunzi.
21.11: Bakhipha izingane zabo njengomhlambi; abantwana babo bayagida.
21.12: Bahlabelela ngesigubhu nangehabhu,* bathokoza ngezwi lomtshingo.
21.13: Baqeda imihla yabo ngokuhle, behlela endaweni yabafileyo ngokuthula.
21.14: Nokho bathi kuNkulunkulu: ‘Suka kithi, asifuni ukwazi izindlela zakho.
21.15: USomandla uyini ukuba simkhonze na? Siyakuzuzani, uma sikhuleka kuye, na?’
21.16: Bhekani, inhlanhla yabo ayisesandleni sabo; icebo lababi malibe kude nami.
21.17: “Kukangaki isibani sababi sicimeka, nengozi ibehlela, babelwe izabelo ngentukuthelo, na?
21.18: Babeyakuba njengezibi phambi komoya, nanjengamakhoba aphephethwa yisiphepho.
21.19: UNkulunkulu ubekela abantwana babo ububi babo; yebo, kodwa makabuphindisele kubo uqobo ukuba babazi.
21.20: Awabo amehlo mawabone ukuchithwa kwabo, bona baphuze ukufutheka kukaSomandla.
21.21: Banokujabula kuni endlini yabo emva kwabo, lapho umumo wezinyanga zabo usunqunyiwe, na?
21.22: UNkulunkulu uyakufundiswa ukwazi, yena owahlulela abaphakemeyo, na?
21.23: “Omunye ufa esemi kahle kukho konke, ezinzile, enokuthula.
21.24: Izinhlangothi zakhe zigcwele amafutha; umnkantsha wamathambo akhe umanzi.
21.25: Omunye ufa enomphefumulo onomunyu, engazange adle okuhle.
21.26: Balala phansi othulini kanyekanye; izimpethu ziyabasibekela.
21.27: Bhekani, ngiyazi imicabango yenu, namacebo enu eniyakungona ngawo.
21.28: Nithi: ‘Iphi indlu yezikhulu, liphi itende lokuhlala kwababi, na?’
21.29: Anibuzanga abadlula endleleni, nibazi ubufakazi babo
21.30: bokuthi omubi ugodlelwa usuku lokubhujiswa nokuthi bayamukiswa ngosuku lwentukuthelo, na?
21.31: Ngubani oyakumtshela indlela yakhe ebusweni bakhe? Ngubani oyakumphindisela ngalokho akwenzileyo na?
21.33: Amagabade asesigodini ayakuba mnandi kuye; bonke abantu bayakudonswa emva kwakhe, njengokuba bengenakubalwa nababe phambi kwakhe.
21.34: “Pho, ningiduduzelani ngeze, lokhu ezimpendulweni zenu kusele inkohliso nje, na?”

22.2: “Umuntu angaba yinsizakalo kuNkulunkulu ukuba ohlakaniphileyo abe nosizo kuye na?
22.3: Kuyintokozo yini kuSomandla, uma ulungile, kuyinzuzo kuye, uma wenza izindlela zakho ziphelele, na?
22.4: “Kungokumesaba kwakho akusolayo, angene nawe ekwahlulelweni, na?
22.5: Ububi bakho abubukhulu yini? Izono zakho azinakuphela.
22.6: Ngokuba uthathe ngeze izibambiso kumfowenu, wahlubula abampofu izingubo zabo.
22.7: Awumphuzisanga owomileyo amanzi, wamgodlela olambileyo ukudla.
22.8: Umuntu onamandla, izwe lingelakhe; onodumo uyahlala kulo.
22.9: Umukisile abafelokazi bengenalutho; izingalo zezintandane zaphuliwe.
22.10: Ngalokho izingibe ziyakuhaqa; uvalo oluzumayo luyakwethusa.
22.11: Ukukhanya kwakho kuphenduke ubumnyama, ukuze ungaboni, nesikhukhula samanzi siyakusibekela.
22.12: “UNkulunkulu akakho ekuphakameni kwezulu na? Bheka inhloko yezinkanyezi ukuthi iphakeme kangaka.
22.13: Uthi wena: ‘UNkulunkulu wazini na? Angahlulela engale kwesigayegaye na?
22.14: Amafu ayamsibekela ukuze angaboni; uyahamba esiyingelezini sezulu.’
22.15: Uyakugcina indlela yamandulo eyahanjwa yizoni na?
22.16: Yizo ezahlwitha kungakabi yisikhathi, ezisisekelo sazo sathululwa njengomfula,
22.17: nezathi kuNkulunkulu: ‘Suka kithina, ngokuba uSomandla ubeyakwenzani kubo na?’
22.18: Kepha nguye owayegcwalisa izindlu zabo ngokuhle. Amasu ababi akude nami.
22.21: “Mawujwayelane naye, ube nokuthula; ngalokho okuhle kuyakufika kuwe.
22.22: Mawamukele umthetho emlonyeni wakhe, ubeke amazwi akhe enhliziyweni yakho.
22.23: Uma ubuyela kuSomandla, uyakwakhiwa, uma udedisa okubi kude etendeni lakho,
22.24: ubeke igolide lakho othulini, nelase-Ofiri phakathi kwamatshe eminonjana.
22.25: USomandla uyakuba yigugu lakho, nesiliva elikhazimulayo kuwe,
22.26: ngokuba lapho uyakuthokoza ngoSomandla, uphakamisele kuNkulunkulu ubuso bakho.
22.27: Uyakukhuleka kuye, akuzwe, wena ugcwalise izithembiso zakho.
22.28: Uma unquma indaba, uyakuyenzelwa, ukukhanya kukhanye ezindleleni zakho.
22.30: Abantu abangemsulwa uyakubakhulula nabo, bakhululwe ngobumhlophe bezandla zakho.”

23.2: “Nanamuhla ukukhala kwami kumunyu; isandla sami siyasinda ngokububula kwami.
23.3: Sengathi ngingazi ukuthi ngiyakumtholaphi, ngize ngifike endlini yakhe,
23.4: ngilungise ukwahlulelwa kwami phambi kwakhe, ngigcwalise umlomo wami ngezimpendulo.
23.5: Bengiyakuwazi amazwi abeyakungiphendula ngawo, ngiqonde ukuthi ubeyakuthini kimi.
23.6: Ubeyakuphikisana nami ngamandla akhe amakhulu na? Cha, ubeyakubhekisa kimi.
23.7: Lapho olungileyo ubeyakuphikisana naye, mina ngikhululwe kumahluleli wami kuze kube phakade.
23.8: Kodwa bheka, ngiya empumalanga, kepha akakho, nasentshonalanga, kepha angimboni,
23.9: nangasenyakatho ekusebenzeni kwakhe, kepha akabonwa; ujikela ngaseningizimu, kepha akabonakali.
23.10: Ngokuba uyayazi indlela yami; esengivivinyile, ngiyakuphuma njengegolide.
23.11: Unyawo lwami lunamathele ezinyathelweni zakhe; ngigcinile indlela yakhe, angiphambukanga.
23.12: Angichezukanga emyalweni wezindebe zakhe; ngizibekele amazwi akhe kunezimiso zami.
23.13: “Kodwa uyinto inye, ngubani ongambuyisa na? Okufisayo umphefumulo wakhe, lokho uyakwenza.
23.14: Uyakufeza engikumiselweyo; izinto eziningi ezinjalo zikuye.
23.15: Ngalokho ngishaywa luvalo ebusweni bakhe; lapho ngikuqaphela, ngiyamesaba.
23.16: NguNkulunkulu odangalisileyo inhliziyo yami, uSomandla ungethusile,
23.17: ngokuba anginqunywanga, bungakafiki ubumnyama; wangifihlela ukuhlwa.

24.1: “Kungani ukuba uSomandla angazibekeleli izikhathi zokwahlulela, abamaziyo babone imihla yakhe, na?
24.3: Bamukisa imbongolo yezintandane, nenkomo yomfelokazi bayayithatha ibe yisibambiso.
24.4: Bafuzula abaswelayo endleleni; abampofu bomhlaba bacasha ndawonye.
24.5: Bheka, njengezimbongolo ehlane bayaphumela emisebenzini yabo befunisisa ukudla; ihlane lingukudla kwabo abakunika abantwana babo.
24.6: Emasimini bavuna ifoliji;* bakhothoza esivinini somubi.
24.7: Ebusuku balala nqunu bengenangubo, bengenanto yokuzisibekela emakhazeni.
24.8: Bamanzi ngezihlambi zasezintabeni; basingatha idwala bengenasiphephelo.
24.9: Intandane ihlwithwa ebeleni, nengane yompofu ithathwa ibe yisibambiso,
24.10: bahambe nqunu bengenangubo, bethwele izithungu, belambile.
24.11: Benza amafutha phakathi kwezingange zabahluphi; banyathela izikhamo zewayini, kepha bayoma.
24.12: Bexoshwe emzini abafayo bayabubula; imiphefumulo yabalimeleyo iyakhala, kepha uNkulunkulu akanaki lokho okubi.
24.13: “Bakhona abakuhlubukile ukukhanya; abazi indlela yakho, abanamatheli emikhondweni yakho.
24.14: Umbulali uvuka ekuseni, abulale ompofu noswelayo; ebusuku unjengesela.
24.15: Iso lesiphingi libheka ukuhlwa ngokuthi: ‘Malingangiboni iso,’ sisithe ubuso baso.
24.16: Bafohla izindlu sekumnyama; emini bayazivalela; ukukhanya abakwazi.
24.17: Ngokuba ithunzi lokufa kubo bonke labo linjengokusa, lokhu beyazi ingebhe yethunzi lokufa.
24.18: “Banejubane ebusweni bamanzi; izabelo zabo ziqalekisiwe emhlabeni; abasayikuphendukela endleleni yezivini.
24.19: Ukoma nokushisa kuyaqeda amanzi eqhwa; kanjalo indawo yabafileyo labo abonileyo.
24.20: Isizalo siyamkhohlwa; izimpethu ziyamsobozela; akasayikukhunjulwa; ukungalungi kuyaphulwa njengomuthi.
24.21: Uyayidla inyumba engazaliyo; akenzeli umfelokazi okuhle.
24.22: Uyadonsa namaqhawe ngamandla akhe; uyavuka; akakho osenethemba lokuphila.
24.23: UNkulunkulu uyamnika ukuba alondeke, asekelwe; kepha amehlo akhe aphezu kwezindlela zabo.
24.24: Bayaphakanyiswa; emva kwesikhashana abasekho; bayaphela njengabanye, bafe; babuna njengezihloko zezikhwebu.
24.25: “Uma kungenjalo, ngubani ongangenza onamanga, awenze ize amazwi ami, na?”

25.2: “Ukubusa nokwesabeka kukuye owenza ukuthula ezindaweni zakhe eziphakemeyo.
25.3: Ukhona yini ongabala izimpi zakhe, nokukhanya kwakhe akuphumeli bani na?
25.4: Pho, umuntu angalunga kanjani kuNkulunkulu, nozelwe ngowesifazane angahlambuluka kanjani, na?
25.5: Bheka, nenyanga ayinankazimulo, nezinkanyezi azihlambulukile emehlweni akhe.
25.6: Pho, kakhulu kangakanani umuntu oyimpethu, nendodana yomuntu eyisibungu, na?”

26.2: “Usizile kanjani ongenamandla! Usindisile kanjani ingalo engenamandla?
26.3: Umlulekile kanjani ongenakuhlakanipha! Umemezile kangakanani ukuqonda!
26.4: Utshelwe ngubani lawo mazwi, nomoya kabani waphuma kuwe, na?
26.5: “Izithunzi ziyathuthumela phansi kwamanzi kanye nabakhelwane bawo.
26.6: Indawo yabafileyo ize phambi kwakhe, nendawo yokubhubha ayinasisibekelo.
26.7: Welula inyakatho phezu kwendawo engenalutho; uphanyeka umhlaba phezu kweze.
26.8: Ubopha amanzi emafwini akhe; ifu alidabuki phansi kwawo.
26.9: Uyasibekela ubuso besihlalo sakhe sobukhosi; uyeneka ifu lakhe phezu kwaso.
26.10: Uyingiliza ngomudwa phezu kobuso bamanzi, kuze kuphele ukukhanya ebumnyameni.
26.11: Izinsika zezulu ziyathuthumela; ziyethuswa ngokukhuza kwakhe.
26.12: Ngamandla akhe uyanyakazisa amanzi; ngokuqonda kwakhe uyachitha uRahabi.
26.13: Ngokuphefumula kwakhe izulu liyakhazimula; isandla sakhe sigwazile inyoka esheshayo.
26.14: Bheka, lokhu kungamaphethelo nje ezindlela zakhe, izwi lokunyenyeza nje elizwakalayo ngaye; indumo yamandla akhe, ngubani obeyakuyiqonda na?”

27.1: UJobe wabuye waphakamisa izwi lakhe, wathi:
27.2: “Kuphila kukaNkulunkulu osusile ukwahlulelwa kwami, noSomandla owenze munyu umphefumulo wami,
27.3: kusekhona ukuphefumula kimi, nomoya kaNkulunkulu usemakhaleni ami,
27.4: izindebe zami aziyikukhuluma okubi, nolimi lwami aluyikukhipha inkohliso.
27.5: Makube kude nami ukuba nginivumele; angiyikuzaphuca ukuphelela kwami ngize ngife.
27.6: Ngibambelela ekulungeni kwami, angikuyeki; inhliziyo yami ayisoli nowodwa wemihla yami.
27.8: Liyini ithemba longenaNkulunkulu, nxa enqunywa, lapho uNkulunkulu esusa umphefumulo wakhe, na?
27.9: UNkulunkulu uyakuzwa ukukhala kwakhe, lapho ehlelwa lusizi, na?
27.10: Uyakuthokoza ngoSomandla, ambize uNkulunkulu ngezikhathi zonke, na?
27.12: Bhekani, nina nonke nikubonile; kungani ukuba nizenze ize na?
27.13: “Lokhu kuyisabelo somuntu omubi kuNkulunkulu, nefa lezidlwangudlwangu ezilamukela kuSomandla.
27.14: Uma abantwana bakhe banda, bandela inkemba; inzalo yakhe ayiyikusutha ngokudla.
27.15: Abasele kuye bayakumbelwa ekufeni, abafelokazi babo bangalili.
27.16: Noma enqwabela isiliva njengothuli, alungise izambatho njengodaka,
27.17: makakulungise, kepha kuyakwembathwa ngolungileyo, ongenacala abele isiliva.
27.18: Uyakha indlu yakhe njengenundu, ibe njengedlangala elakhiwa ngumlindi.
27.19: Uyalala enothile, angakuphindi kodwa; uyavula amehlo akhe, abe engasekho.
27.20: Ingebhe iyamehlela njengamanzi; isivunguvungu siyamphephula ebusuku.
27.21: Umoya wasempumalanga uyamthatha, amuke; uyambhengula endaweni yakhe.
27.22: Uyacibishelwa engahawukelwa; uyabaleka nokubaleka esandleni sakhe.
27.23: Abantu bayakumshayela ihlombe, bamncimfele ukuba asuke endaweni yakhe.

28.1: “Impela ukhona umthapho wesiliva, nendawo yegolide abalicwengayo.
28.2: Insimbi iyakhishwa emhlabathini; amatshe ayancibilikiswa abe yithusi.
28.3: Ubumnyama bubekelwa umkhawulo; kuyacingwa kuze kube sekupheleni konke amatshe esigayegaye nethunzi lokufa.
28.4: Baqhekeza umgodi kude nalapho behlala khona abantu, lapho bekhohlakele khona lunyawo; bayalenga, bajikajika kude nabantu.
28.5: Umhlaba-ke, kuwona kuvela ukudla, kepha ngaphansi kwawo uyaphendukezelwa njengangomlilo.
28.6: Amatshe awo ayindawo yamasafire;* inothuli lwegolide.
28.7: Lowo mgudu awaziwa yinqe, neso loheshe aliwubonanga.
28.8: Izilwane ezinkulu azihambanga ngawo, nengonyama ayidlulanga ngawo.
28.9: Uyelulela isandla sakhe etsheni lensengetsha, agumbuqele izintaba kwasezimpandeni zazo.
28.10: Uqhekeza imihohoba emadwaleni; iso lakhe liyabona konke okuyigugu.
28.11: Uyavimba imifula ukuba ingaconsi; imfihlakalo uyayikhiphela ekukhanyeni.
28.12: “Kepha ukuhlakanipha kufumanisekaphi? Iphi indawo yokuqonda na?
28.13: Umuntu kalazi inani lakho; akutholakali ezweni labaphilayo.
28.14: Utwa luthi: ‘Akukho kimi;’ ulwandle luthi: ‘Akukho kimi.’
28.15: Akunakuzuzwa ngegolide; intengo yakho ayinakulinganiswa nesiliva.
28.16: Kungelingane negolide lase-Ofiri, neshohamu* eliyigugu, nesafire.*
28.17: Igolide nengilazi kungelingane nakho; akunakwenaniswa ngezinto zegolide elicwengekileyo.
28.18: Akunakukhulunywa ngekorali* nangekristalu;* intengo yakho iphezu kwamarubi.*
28.19: Itopazi* laseKushe alinakulinganiswa nakho, kungelingane negolide elicwengekileyo.
28.20: “Ukuhlakanipha kuvelaphi na? Indawo yokuqonda iphi na?
28.21: Kusithekile emehlweni abo bonke abaphilayo, kufihliwe ezinyonini zezulu.
28.22: Ukubhujiswa nokufa kuthi: ‘Ngezindlebe zethu sizwile amahemuhemu akho.’
28.23: UNkulunkulu uyaqonda indlela yakho; yena uyazi indawo yakho.
28.24: Ngokuba uyabeka imikhawulo yomhlaba, abone konke okuphansi kwezulu.
28.25: Lapho emisela umoya ukusinda kwawo, elinganisa amanzi ngezilinganiso,
28.26: lapho enzela imvula isimiso, nonyazi lokuduma indlela,
28.27: khona wakubona, walanda ngakho, wakuhlela, wakuphenya.
28.28: Wathi kubantu: ‘Bhekani, ukwesaba iNkosi lokhu kungukuhlakanipha; ukusuka ebubini kungukuqonda.’ ”

29.1: UJobe wabuye waphakamisa izwi lakhe, wathi:
29.2: “Sengathi nga nginjengasezinyangeni zakuqala, njengasemihleni uNkulunkulu angigcina ngayo,
29.3: lapho isibani sakhe sasikhanya phezu kwekhanda lami, ngihamba ebumnyameni ngokukhanya kwakhe,
29.4: yebo, njengasezinsukwini zokuvuthwa kwami, lapho ubuhlobo bukaNkulunkulu babuphezu kwetende lami;
29.5: lapho uSomandla wabe esenami, nabantwana bami babe besangizungeza;
29.6: lapho izinyathelo zami zagezwa ngamangqanga, nedwala elalingakimi langithelela imifula yamafutha.
29.7: “Lapho ngaphuma ngaya esangweni ngasemzini, ngalungisa isihlalo sami esigcawini,
29.8: izinsizwa zangibona, zacasha, nezimpunga zasuka zema,
29.9: izikhulu zayeka ukukhuluma, zabeka izandla emilonyeni yazo;
29.10: izwi labakhulu lathuliswa; izilimi zabo zanamathela olwangeni lwabo.
29.11: Lapho indlebe yangizwa, yangibusisa, nalapho iso langibona, langifakazela.
29.12: Ngokuba ngakhulula abampofu abakhalayo kanye nentandane engenamsizi.
29.13: Isibusiso sobezakubhubha safika phezu kwami; ngenza inhliziyo yomfelokazi ukuba ihube ngokujabula.
29.14: Ngembatha ukulunga, kwaba yisambatho kimi; ukwahlulelwa kwami kwakunjengengubo nomqhele kimi.
29.17: Ngaphula imihlathi yowonayo, ngahlwitha impango emazinyweni akhe.
29.18: “Ngase ngithi: ‘Ngiyakufa esidlekeni sami, ngandise izinsuku zami zibe ngangesihlabathi.
29.19: Impande yami iyazivulela amanzi; amazolo alala ubusuku bonke egatsheni lami;
29.20: udumo lwami lusha njalo kimi, umnsalo wami wenziwa musha esandleni sami.’
29.22: Emva kwamazwi ami ababe besakhuluma; amazwi ami aconsela phezu kwabo.
29.23: Bangilindela njengemvula; bangikhamisela imilomo yabo njengokukhamisela imvula yamuva.
29.24: Ngabahleka bengenakukholwa; ukukhanya kobuso bami kabakufiphazanga.
29.25: Uma ngangikhethile izindlela zabo, ngangiyakuhlala emqoka, ngahlalisa okwenkosi empini, njengoduduza abalilayo.

30.1: “Kepha manje abancane ngeminyaka kunami bayangihleka, oyise babo engangibadelela ukuba ngingababeki naphakathi kwezinja zezimvu zami.
30.2: Yebo, namandla ezandla zabo angangisiza kanjani, abantu abaphelile iziphika, na?
30.3: Bondile ngokuswela nangendlala; baququda ugwadule oluyize, olwaluyilohle nakuqala.
30.4: Bayakha imifino kasawoti ezihlahleni; izimpande zezinwele zingukudla kwabo.
30.5: Bayaxoshwa phakathi kwabantu; bamemeza emva kwabo njengasemva kwamasela.
30.6: Bahlala ezigodini ezesabekayo, nesemihumeni yomhlaba, naseziweni.
30.7: Bayakhonya phakathi kwezihlahla; phansi kwezimbabazane bayabuthana,
30.8: bengabantwana beziwula, abantwana babangenamagama, beshaywa, bexoshwa ezweni.
30.10: Bayanengwa yimi, bemi kude nami; abayeki ukungikhafulela ngamathe.
30.11: Bakhululile imichilo yabo, bangithobisa; balahlile itomu phambi kwami.
30.12: Ngakwesokunene kuvuka amachwensa; agudlumeza izinyawo zami, anginqwabelela izindlela zokubhubhisa.
30.13: Achitha umkhondo wami; asebenzela ukubhujiswa kwami engazibambi.
30.14: Angena kungathi ngesikhala esibanzi; phakathi kwencithakalo atheleka phezu kwami.
30.15: Ingebhe ithululwa phezu kwami; njengomoya luyaxoshwa udumo lwami; inhlalakahle yami iyadlula njengefu.
30.16: “Manje umphefumulo wami uthululiwe phakathi kwami; izinsuku zosizi zingibambile.
30.17: Ebusuku amathambo ami ayabhotshozwa, asuke kimi; ubuhlungu obungigedlayo abuphumuli.
30.18: Ngamandla amakhulu umzimba wami wonakele; unamathela kimi njengentamo yesambatho sami.
30.20: “Ngikhala kuwe, kepha awungiphenduli; ngimi lapha, uyangibuka nje.
30.21: Uyaguquka ukuze ungiphathe ngonya; ngamandla esandla sakho uyangizingela.
30.22: Uyangiphakamisela emoyeni, ungikhwelisa kuwo, wenze ukuba ngincibilike ngokuhlokoma kwesivunguvungu.
30.23: Ngokuba ngiyazi ukuthi ungiyisa ekufeni nasendlini yokubuthana kwabaphilayo bonke.
30.24: “Kepha umuntu angelule isandla sakhe encithakalweni, akhale uma esengozini, na?
30.25: Angimkhalelanga yini ozinsuku zakhe zazilukhuni na? Umphefumulo wami awuhawukelanga abampofu na?
30.26: Lapho ngabheka okuhle, kwafika okubi; ngalindela ukukhanya, kwafika ubumnyama.
30.27: Izibilini zami ziyaxhuxhuzela, aziphumuli; izinsuku zosizi zingehlele.
30.28: Ngihamba ngimnyama, kungenziwanga yilanga; ngisukuma ebandleni ngikhala.
30.30: Isikhumba sami simnyama, siyebuza kimi; amathambo ami ashile ngokushisa.
30.31: Ihabhu* lami seliphenduke isililo, nomtshingo wami uyizwi labakhalayo.

31.1: “Ngenza isivumelwano namehlo ami: ngingabuka kanjani intombi na?
31.2: Ngokuba siyini isabelo ebesiyakuvela kuNkulunkulu phezulu, nefa likaSomandla ebeliyakuvela ekuphakameni, na?
31.3: Akusikho ukubhubha kwabangalungile nengozi kwabenza okubi na?
31.4: Yena akaboni izindlela zami, abale izinyathelo zami zonke, na?
31.5: “Uma ngihambile ngamanga, nonyawo lwami luphuthume enkohlisweni,
31.6: mangilinganiswe ngesilinganiso esilungileyo, ukuze uNkulunkulu azi ukuphelela kwami.
31.7: Uma izinyathelo zami zichezukile endleleni, inhliziyo yami yalandela amehlo ami, uma kunamathela isisihla ezandleni zami,
31.8: mangihlwanyele, kudle omunye, yebo, zisishulwe izithelo zami.
31.9: “Uma inhliziyo yami iyengwe ngowesifazane, ngaqamekela ngasemnyango womakhelwane wami,
31.10: umkami makasilele omunye, kuguqe abanye phezu kwakhe.
31.11: Ngokuba lokho ngabe kuyicala, ngabe kungububi bokujeziswa.
31.12: Ngokuba kungumlilo odlayo kuze kube sekubhujisweni, kusishulwe yonke inzuzo yami.
31.13: “Uma ngidelele ukwahlulelwa kwenceku yami noma okwencekukazi yami, lapho bephikisana nami,
31.14: ngiyakwenze njani, lapho uNkulunkulu evuka, nalapho engiphenya, ngingaphendula ngokuthini na?
31.15: Owangenza mina esiswini, wabenza nabo; owasibumba esizalweni munye.
31.16: “Uma nginqabele abampofu abakufisayo, ngenza amehlo omfelokazi ukuba afiphale,
31.17: ngadla ucezu lwami lwesinkwa ngingedwa, ingaludlanga nentandane
31.18: hhayi, ikhulele kimi kwasebusheni bami njengakuyise; kwasesizalweni sikamame ngangingumholi wabafelokazi
31.19: uma ngibone obhubhile ngokuswela isambatho, kungekho okokuzimboza kompofu;
31.20: uma ukhalo lwakhe lungangibusisanga, uma engafudunyezwanga nguboya bezimvu zami;
31.21: uma ngiphakamisele intandane isandla sami, ngokuba ngabona usizo lwami esangweni,
31.22: maliwe ihlombe lami esiphangeni, nengalo yami yaphulwe enkothweni yayo.
31.23: Ngokuba ngesaba ukubhujiswa nguNkulunkulu; ngenxa yokuphakama kwakhe bengingenakwenza lutho.
31.24: “Uma ngibeke igolide libe yithemba lami, ngathi egolideni elihle: ‘Ngithemba wena;’
31.25: uma ngithokozile, ngokuba imfuyo yami inkulu nangokuba isandla sami sithole okuningi;
31.26: uma ngibone ukukhanya ukuthi kuyakhazimula, nenyanga ukuthi ihamba ngencwazimulo,
31.27: kwayengwa inhliziyo yami esitha, nomlomo wanga isandla sami,
31.28: nalokho kwakungububi bokujeziswa, ngokuba ngangimphikile uNkulunkulu phezulu.
31.29: “Uma ngithokozile ngengozi yongizondayo, ngaxhuma lapho eficwa ngokubi
31.30: kepha angivumelanga ulimi lwami ukuba lone ngokucela ukuphila kwakhe ngesifungo
31.31: uma abantu betende lami bengashongo ukuthi: ‘Ngubani ongathola umuntu ongasuthanga ngenyama yakhe na?’ –
31.32: abafokazi kabalalanga phandle, ngavulela izihambi iminyango yami –
31.33: uma ngisibekele iziphambeko zami njengo-Adamu ngokufihla ububi bami esifubeni sami,
31.34: ngokuba ngesaba isixuku esikhulu, ngaba novalo lokudelelwa ngabomndeni, ngaze ngathula, angaphuma emnyango –
31.35: sengathi angaba khona ongizwayo nantu uphawu lwami, makangiphendule uSomandla – ngibe nencwadi ayilobileyo omelana nami!
31.36: Ngangiyakuyithwala emahlombe ami, ngiyibophe ibe ngumqhele kimi,
31.37: ngimlandise ngomumo wezinyathelo zami, ngisondele kuye njengesikhulu.
31.38: “Uma umhlaba wami ukhalile ngami, nemisele yawo ililile kanyekanye;
31.39: uma ngidlile izithelo zawo ngingenamali, ngenza ukuba bafe abaniniwo,
31.40: makuhlume ikhakhasi esikhundleni sikakolweni, kuvele ukhula endaweni yebhali.”* Amazwi kaJobe asephelile.

32.1: Lawo madoda amathathu ayeseyeka ukumphendula uJobe, ngokuba wayelungile emehlweni akhe.
32.2: Lwase luvutha ulaka luka-Elihu, indodana kaBarakeli, umBuzi womndeni kaRamu; ulaka lwakhe lwavuthela uJobe, ngokuba wazithetha yena kunoNkulunkulu.
32.3: Ulaka lwakhe lwavuthela nabangane bakhe abathathu, ngokuba noma bengafumananga impendulo, bamlahla nokho uJobe.
32.4: U-Elihu wayelindele ukukhuluma kuJobe, ngokuba bona babebadala kunaye.
32.5: Lapho u-Elihu esebona ukuthi ayikho impendulo emilonyeni yalawo madoda amathathu, lwavutha ulaka lwakhe.
32.6: U-Elihu, indodana kaBarakeli, umBuzi, wayesethatha-ke, wathi: “Mina ngisemusha ngeminyaka, nina nibadala; ngalokho nganginamahloni, ngesaba ukunitshela umqondo wami.
32.7: Ngathi: ‘Makukhulume izinsuku, ubuningi beminyaka bazise ukuhlakanipha.’
32.8: Nokho kukhona umoya kumuntu; ukuphefumula kukaSomandla kuyabaqondisa.
32.10: “Ngalokho ngithi: Ngizweni; nami ngiyakusho umqondo wami.
32.11: Bhekani, ngilindele amazwi enu, ngabeka indlebe emiqondweni yenu, nisaphenya eniyakukusho.
32.12: Nganilalela nina; bhekani, kwakungekho noyedwa owamahlula uJobe nowaphendula amazwi akhe phakathi kwenu.
32.13: Maningasho ukuthi: ‘Sifumene ukuhlakanipha; uNkulunkulu angamphengulula, hhayi umuntu.’
32.14: Akahlelelanga mina amazwi akhe; angiyikumphendula ngezinkulumo zenu.
32.16: Ngibalindele yini, uma bengakhulumi, na? Ngokuba bemi bengasaphenduli.
32.17: Nami ngiyakuphendula okwami, ngitshengise nami umqondo wami.
32.18: Ngokuba ngigcwele amazwi; umoya phakathi kwami uyangiqhubezela.
32.19: Bhekani, okuphakathi kwami kunjengewayini elingenambobo; kucishe ukuqhuma njengezimvaba ezintsha.
32.20: Ngiyakukhuluma ukuba ngikhululeke; ngiyakuvula izindebe zami ukuba ngiphendule.
32.22: Ngokuba angikwazi ukuthopha; uma kunjalo, uMenzi wami angangisusa masinyane.

33.2: Bheka-ke, sengivula umlomo wami; ulimi lwami lukhuluma emlonyeni wami.
33.3: Amazwi ami avela enhliziyweni yami eqotho; okwaziwa yizindebe zami ziyakukhuluma ngesiminya.
33.4: Umoya kaNkulunkulu ungenzile, nokuphefumula kukaSomandla kunginika ukuphila.
33.5: Uma ukwazi, ngiphendule; zihlele phambi kwami, ume.
33.6: Bheka, nginjengawe maqondana noNkulunkulu: ngibunjiwe nami ngebumba.
33.7: Bheka, ingebhe ngami ayiyikukugebhezisa, nesandla sami esiphezu kwakho asiyikukusinda.
33.8: “Impela wakhuluma ezindlebeni zami, ngezwa izwi lokukhuluma kwakho ukuthi:
33.9: Ngimsulwa, anginasiphambeko; ngimhlophe, akukho okubi kimi.
33.10: Bheka, uthola amathuba ngami, ungishaya isitha sakhe.
33.11: Ufaka izinyawo zami ezingongolweni, aqaphele zonke izindlela zami.
33.12: “Bheka, ngiyakuphendula ukuthi awuthethanga kahle lokho, ngokuba uNkulunkulu mkhulu kunomuntu.
33.13: Umphikiselani ngokuthi: Akaphenduli nelilodwa lamazwi ami.
33.14: Ngokuba uNkulunkulu ukhuluma kanye, yebo, nakabili, umuntu engakunaki.
33.15: Ephusheni nasembonweni wasebusuku, lapho abantu behlelwe ngubuthongo obunzima, bozela emacansini,
33.16: khona uyavula izindlebe zabantu, abeke uphawu ekufundisweni kwabo,
33.17: ukuze aphambukise umuntu ekwenzeni kwakhe, anqume ukuzidla kumuntu;
33.18: unqanda umphefumulo wakhe ekubhujisweni, nokuphila kwakhe ukuba kungachithwa ngomkhonto.
33.19: Uyajeziswa ngobuhlungu nasecansini lakhe, nangokulwa okungapheliyo emathanjeni akhe.
33.20: Inhliziyo iyanengwa ngukudla, nomphefumulo wakhe uzonda ukudla okade ukufisa.
33.21: Inyama yakhe iyadliwa, ingabe isabonwa; amathambo akhe akade engabonakali aseqhamukile.
33.22: Umphefumulo wakhe uyasondela egodini, nokuphila kwakhe kubabulali.
33.23: “Uma kukhona ingelosi kuye, nehumusha noma yiliphi enkulungwaneni lokuba litshele umuntu okumlungeleyo,
33.24: uNkulunkulu abeseba nomusa kuye, athi: ‘Mkhulule ukuba angehleli egodini, sengitholile ihlawulo,’
33.25: inyama yakhe ibe ntsha kuneyomntwana, abuyele emihleni yobusha bakhe,
33.26: khona uyakunxusa uNkulunkulu ukuba abe nomusa kuye, abone ubuso bakhe ngokujabula, abesebuyisela kumuntu ukulunga kwakhe.
33.27: Usehlabelela phambi kwabantu, uthi: ‘Ngonile, ngahlanekezela ukulunga, kepha akwenziwanga kimi njengokufaneleyo:
33.28: uhlengile umphefumulo wami ukuba ungadluleli egodini; ngiyakubona ukukhanya ngiphila.’
33.29: “Bhekani, konke lokhu uNkulunkulu uyakwenza kabili, yebo, kathathu kumuntu
33.30: ukuba abuyise umphefumulo wakhe egodini, akhanyiselwe ngokukhanya kwabaphilayo.
33.31: Yizwa, Jobe, ungilalele; thula, mina ngizakukhuluma.
33.32: Uma unamazwi, ngiphendule; khuluma, ngokuba ngifisa ukukuthethelela.
33.33: Uma ungenawo, ngilalele wena; thula, ngiyakukufundisa ukuhlakanipha.”

34.2: “Yizwani amazwi ami, nina zihlakaniphi, nibeke indlebe kimi nina zazi.
34.3: Ngokuba indlebe iyavivinya amazwi, njengokuba ulwanga luzwa ukudla.
34.4: Masizikhethele okulungileyo, sazi phakathi kwethu okuhle.
34.5: Ngokuba uJobe uthe: ‘Ngilungile; uNkulunkulu ususile ukwahlulelwa kwami.
34.6: Phezu kokwahlulelwa kwami ngishaywa onamanga; inxeba lami alinakupholiswa, noma ngingenasiphambeko.’
34.7: Ngumuphi umuntu onjengoJobe ophuza usulu njengamanzi,
34.8: ohamba ngokwazana nabenza okubi, ahambisane nabantu ababi, na?
34.9: Ngokuba uthi: ‘Akunalusizo kumuntu ukuba azane noNkulunkulu.’
34.10: “Ngalokho ngizweni nina bantu abanokuqonda; makube kude noNkulunkulu ukuba enze okubi, nakuSomandla ukuba enze ukona.
34.11: Ngokuba uyabuyisela kumuntu njengokwenza kwakhe, atholise kube yilowo nalowo njengezindlela zakhe.
34.12: Impela uNkulunkulu akenzi okubi; uSomandla kahlanekezeli ukwahlulela.
34.13: Ngubani owambeka phezu komhlaba na? Ngubani owamisa izwe lonke na?
34.14: Uma ebeyakuzibheka yena, azibuyisele umoya wakhe nomphefumulo wakhe,
34.15: inyama yonke ibiyakufa kanyekanye, umuntu abuyele othulini.
34.16: “Uma unengqondo, yizwa lokhu, ulalele izwi lokukhuluma kwami.
34.17: Imbala ozonda ukwahlulela uyakubusa na? Uyakumlahla olungileyo nonamandla
34.19: ongakhethi ubuso bezikhulu, onganaki ocebileyo kunompofu, na? Ngokuba bonke bangumsebenzi wezandla zakhe.
34.20: Bayafa ngokuphazima kweso; phakathi kwamabili abantu bayathuthumela, banyamalale; amaqhawe ayasuswa, kepha kungengasandla.
34.21: “Ngokuba amehlo akhe akuzo izindlela zomuntu; ubona zonke izinyathelo zakhe.
34.22: Abukho ubumnyama, nethunzi lokufa alikho, lapho abenza okubi bengacasha khona.
34.23: Ngokuba akadingi ukuba abelokhu ebheka umuntu ukuba aye kuNkulunkulu ukwahlulelwa.
34.24: Uyaphahlaza abanamandla, kungahlolwanga, amise abanye ezikhundleni zabo.
34.25: Ngalokho uyazi imisebenzi yabo; uyabagumbuqela ebusuku, bachotshozwe.
34.26: Uyabashaya njengababi endaweni lapho bebonwa khona,
34.27: ngokuba bachezuka ekumlandeleni, abanakanga neyodwa yezindlela zakhe,
34.28: baze benza ukuba ukukhala kwabampofu kufike kuye, wezwa ukukhala kwabahluphekayo.
34.29: Lapho yena ethula, ngubani ongalahla, nalapho ethukusa ubuso bakhe, ngubani ongambona na? Ubusa ngokufananayo, noma kuyisizwe noma kungumuntu,
34.30: ukuba kungabusi muntu ongenaNkulunkulu, abantu bacushwe.
34.31: “Ngokuba ukhona oke wathi kuNkulunkulu: ‘Ngithweswe icala noma ngingonanga, na?
34.32: Lokhu engingakuboni, ngifundise khona; uma ngenzile okubi, angisayikukuphinda.’
34.33: Uyakuphindisela njengokuthanda kwakho, lokhu ukwenqaba, na? Ngokuba nguwe ozakukhetha, akusimina; khuluma okwaziyo.
34.34: “Abantu abanokuqonda bayakusho kimi, yebo, nezihlakaniphi, lapho zingizwa, ziyakuthi:
34.36: Sengathi uJobe angavivinywa kuze kube sekupheleni, ngokuba uphendula njengabantu ababi.
34.37: Ngokuba uyenezela ukuhlubuka esonweni sakhe; ushaya ihlombe phakathi kwethu, andise amazwi akhe kuNkulunkulu.”

35.2: “Usho uthi lokhu kulungile na? Uthi: ‘Yilungelo lami kuNkulunkulu yini,’
35.3: njengokuba uthi: ‘Kungisiza ngani?’ nokuthi: ‘Ngizuzeni kunalokho ebengiyakukuzuza, uma ngonile, na?’
35.5: Bheka ngasezulwini, ubone, uqaphele amafu aphakeme kunawe.
35.6: Uma wona, wenzani kuye na? Uma iziphambeko zakho ziziningi, wenzani kuyena na?
35.7: Uma ulungile, umnikani yena, noma umukelani esandleni sakho na?
35.8: Ububi bakho buqondene nomuntu onjengawe, nokulunga kwakho kuthintana nendodana yomuntu.
35.9: “Abantu bakhala ngobuningi bezinkahlo; bakhala ngokusizwa ngenxa yengalo yabanamandla.
35.10: Kepha akakho othi: ‘Uphi uNkulunkulu, uMenzi wami, ozwakalisa amahubo ebusuku,
35.11: osifundisa phezu kwezilwane zomhlaba, asenze sihlakaniphe phezu kwezinyoni zezulu.’
35.12: Lapho bayakhala ngokuzidla kwababi, kepha akaphenduli.
35.13: Impela uNkulunkulu akezwa okuyize, uSomandla akayikukunakekela;
35.14: kakhulu kangakanani, lapho uthi awumboni nokuthi, noma icala liphambi kwakhe, usamhlalela, na?
35.15: Kepha manje, ngokuba intukuthelo yakhe ingajezisi, anganaki kakhulu iziphambeko,
35.16: uJobe uvulela ize umlomo wakhe; uyandisa amazwi engenalwazi.”

36.2: “Ngihlalele kancane, ngiyakukubonisa, ngokuba ngisenamazwi okummela uNkulunkulu.
36.3: Ngiyakulanda kude ulwazi lwami, nginike uMenzi wami ukulunga.
36.4: Impela amazwi ami awasiwo amanga; unawe ophelele ekwazini.
36.5: “Bheka, uNkulunkulu unamandla, kepha kadeleli muntu; mkhulu emandleni okuqonda.
36.6: Akenzi ukuba omubi aphile, kepha abampofu uyabanika ukwahlulelwa.
36.7: Akabuyisi amehlo akhe kwabalungileyo, kepha ubahlalisa namakhosi ezihlalweni zobukhosi, baphakame kuze kube phakade.
36.8: Uma beboshwa ngamaketanga, babanjwe ngezintambo zokuhlupheka,
36.9: uyababonisa izenzo zabo neziphambeko zabo zokuthi baziphakamisile.
36.10: Uyavulela izindlebe zabo ukulaywa, asho ukuba babuye ebubini.
36.11: Uma belalela, bamkhonze, bayakuqeda imihla yabo ebuhleni neminyaka yabo kukho okumnandi.
36.12: Kepha uma bengalaleli, bayakuphela ngenkemba, bafe bengenalwazi.
36.13: “Abangesabi ngenhliziyo baqongelela ulaka; abakhali lapho ebabopha.
36.14: Bafa besebasha, ukuphila kwabo kube njengokwezifebe zethempeli.
36.15: Ukhulula ompofu ngobumpofu bakhe, avule indlebe yabo ngokuhlupheka.
36.16: “Yebo, nga ekuvusa ukuba uphume emlonyeni wosizi, uye endaweni ebanzi, lapho kungekho kunyinyeka khona, kunone okubekwa etafuleni lakho.
36.17: Kepha ugcwele ukwahlulelwa kwababi; ukwahlulela nokulunga kuyakubamba.
36.18: Xwaya ukuba ulaka lungakuvusi usashaywa, ungachezukiswa ngobuningi bamahlawulo.
36.19: Ukukhala kwakho kungakusiza ukuba ungahlali osizini, nazo zonke izikhwepha zamandla akho, na?
36.20: Ungafisi ubusuku, lapho abantu beyakususwa ezindaweni zabo.
36.21: Xwaya ukuba ungabhekisi ubuso bakho ebubini, ngokuba ukhethile lokho kunokuhlupheka.
36.22: “Bheka, uNkulunkulu uphakeme ngamandla akhe; ngubani ofundisa njengaye na?
36.23: Ngubani ommisele indlela yakhe na? Ngubani ongasho ukuthi: ‘Wenzile okubi,’ na?
36.24: Khumbula ukukhulisa izenzo zakhe abahlabelela ngazo abantu.
36.25: Bonke abantu bayazibona; abokufa bayazibuka besekude.
36.26: Bheka, uNkulunkulu uphakeme, asimqondi; umumo weminyaka yakhe ayinakuphenywa.
36.27: “Wenyusa amathonsi amanzi, abuye awathulule njengemvula enkungwini yakhe;
36.28: amafu awenza ukuba aconse, awathele phezu kwabantu abaningi.
36.29: Ukhona ongaqonda ukwenekeka kwamafu nokuduma kwedokodo lakhe na?
36.30: Bheka, uyasakaza ukukhanya kwakhe ngakuye; uyasibekela ubuphansi bolwandle.
36.31: Ngokuba ngalokho uyabahlulela abantu, aphane kakhulu ngokudla.
36.32: Uyasibekela izandla zakhe ngokukhanya, akuyale ukuba kushaye isigcibisholo.
36.33: Umsindo wakhe ulanda ngaye oshisekela ububi ngentukuthelo.

37.1: “Yebo, ngenxa yalokho iyathuthumela inhliziyo yami, isuke endaweni yayo.
37.2: Yizwani, nizwe indumo yezwi lakhe, nemvunge ephuma emlonyeni wakhe.
37.3: Uyakukhipha phansi kwalo lonke izulu, nonyazi lwakhe luya emagumbini omhlaba.
37.4: Emva kwalo kuduma izwi; uduma ngezwi lobukhosi bakhe; kalumisi unyazi, lapho lizwakala izwi lakhe.
37.5: UNkulunkulu uyaduma ngezwi lakhe ngokumangalisayo; wenza izinto ezinkulu esingaziqondi.
37.6: Ngokuba uthi eqhweni: ‘Khithika emhlabeni;’ kanjalo nasesihlambini semvula, yebo, ezihlambini zemvula zakhe ezinamandla.
37.7: Uyanamathelisa izandla zabantu bonke ukuba bonke abantu bazi imisebenzi yakhe.
37.8: Seziya izilwane ezikhundleni zazo, zihlale emihumeni yazo.
37.9: Isikhwishikhwishi siphuma ekamelweni laso, namakhaza emimoyeni ehlakazayo.
37.10: Ngokuphefumula kukaNkulunkulu kuvela ungqoqwane, ububanzi bamanzi buqine.
37.11: Yebo, uyathwesa amafu ngokuswakama; uyeneka amafu onyazi lwakhe.
37.12: Ayajika, aphenduke njengokunquma kwakhe ukuba enze konke awayalayo ebusweni bomhlaba owakhiweyo,
37.13: awafikise abe luswazi, afike ngenxa yomhlaba noma ngenxa yomusa.
37.14: “Beka indlebe kulokhu, Jobe; yima, uqonde izimangaliso zikaNkulunkulu.
37.15: Uyazi yini ukuthi uNkulunkulu uwayala kanjani, enze ukuba unyazi lwamafu akhe lukhanye na?
37.16: Uyaqonda yini ukulinganiswa kwamafu, izimangaliso zoPhelele olwazini,
37.17: wena ozingubo zakho zifudumala, lapho ethulisa umhlaba ngeshisandlu, na?
37.18: Ungeneka isibhakabhaka njengaye, esiqinile njengesibuko esibunjiweyo, na?
37.19: Sifundise ukuthi siyakuthini kuye; asinakuhlela indaba yethu ngenxa yobumnyama.
37.20: Uyakutshelwa ukuthi ngiyakhuluma na? Ukhona yini oshoyo ukuthi makabhubhe na?
37.21: Manje, abantu abanakukubona ukukhanya okukhazimula esibhakabhakeni, lapho umoya usudlulile, wasihlanza.
37.22: Ngasenyakatho kuvela inkazimulo yegolide; uNkulunkulu wembethe ubukhosi obesabekayo.
37.23: USomandla singemqonde; mkhulu ngamandla nangokwahlulela; ngokulunga kwakhe okukhulu akoni lutho.
37.24: Ngalokho abantu bayamesaba; kepha akanaki abazishaya izihlakaniphi ngenhliziyo.”

38.2: “Ngubani lo owenza mnyama isiluleko ngamazwi angenalwazi na?
38.3: Bopha izinkalo zakho njengendoda; ngizakukubuza, wena ungazise.
38.4: Wawukuphi, lapho ngasekela umhlaba, na? Ngitshele, uma ukwazi ukuqonda.
38.5: Ngubani owanquma izilinganiso zawo, ngokuba uyakwazi phela! Ngubani owelula umucu wokulinganisa phezu kwawo na?
38.6: Izisekelo zawo zabekwa phezu kwani na? Ngubani owabeka itshe lawo legumbi,
38.7: lapho izinkanyezi zokusa zahlabelela kanyekanye, nawo onke amadodana kaNkulunkulu ajabula, na?
38.8: “Ngubani owavalela ulwandle ngezicabha, lapha lwabhoboka kungathi lwaphuma esiswini,
38.9: lapho ngabeka amafu aba yisambatho salo, nesigayegaye saba yimbeleko yalo,
38.10: nalapho ngalumisela umncele wami, ngamisa imigoqo nezicabha,
38.11: ngathi: ‘Uyakufika lapha, kepha ungadluli; lapha amaza akho aziqhenyayo ayakumiswa,’ na?
38.12: “Emihleni yakho uyalile ukusa, wazisa umthende wokusa indawo yawo
38.13: ukuba ubambe amagumbi omhlaba, ababi bathintithwe kuwo, na?
38.14: Uguquka njengebumba lophawu lokunamathelisa; konke kuqhamuka kungathi kwembesiwe.
38.15: Ababi sebenqatshelwe ukukhanya kwabo, nengalo ephakemeyo yaphuliwe.
38.16: “Wake wangena emithonjeni yolwandle, wahamba phansi otweni, na?
38.17: Amasango okufa uwavulelwe, wabona amasango ethunzi lokufa, na?
38.18: Uqondile ububanzi bomhlaba na? Yisho, uma ukwazi konke.
38.19: “Iphi indlela eya lapho kuhlala khona ukukhanya, nobumnyama-ke, iphi indawo yabo,
38.20: ukuze ukuyise emkhawulweni wakho, uqonde imikhondo yendlu yakho, na?
38.21: Angithi uyakwazi, ngokuba wawusuzelwe, nomumo wemihla yakho mkhulu, na?
38.22: “Wake wangena ezinqolobaneni zeqhwa, wabona izinqwaba zesichotho,
38.23: engiziqongelele isikhathi sokuhlupheka nosuku lokulwa nolwempi, na?
38.24: Iphi indlela eya lapho ukukhanya kwahlukaniselwa khona, nalapho umoya wasempumalanga uhlakazekela khona emhlabeni, na?
38.25: Ngubani ovulele ukuchichima kwamanzi umsele nonyazi lokuduma indlela,
38.26: ukunisa imvula emhlabeni lapho kungekho muntu khona, nasehlane elingenamuntu,
38.27: ukusuthisa ihlane kwahlongasibi, nokuhlumisa uhlaza, na?
38.28: Kukhona uyise wemvula na? Ngubani owazala amathonsi amazolo na?
38.29: Iqhwa lavela esiswini sikabani, nesithwathwa sazalwa ngubani, na?
38.30: Amanzi ayacasha kungathi ayitshe; ubuso botwa buhlangene.
38.31: “Ungabopha amaketanga esiLimela, uthukulule izintambo zeMpambano, na?
38.32: Ungakhipha izinkanyezi ngesikhathi sazo, uhole iBhere* nabantwana balo, na?
38.33: Uyazazi izimiso zasezulwini, umise ukumisa kwazo emhlabeni, na?
38.34: “Ungaphakamisela izwi lakho emafwini, ukuze amanzi amaningi akusibekele, na?
38.35: Ungathuma imibani ukuba ihambe, isho kuwe, ithi: ‘Bheka, silapha’?
38.36: Ngubani obeke ukuhlakanipha phakathi komuntu, ngubani onika ukuqonda enhliziyweni na?
38.37: Ngubani ongabala amafu ngokuhlakanipha, ngubani ongathulula izimvaba zasezulwini,
38.38: lapho uthuli luphenduka isigaxa, namagabade anamathelane, na?
38.40: lapho elala emihumeni yawo, ehlezi esikhundleni eqamekele, na?
38.41: Ngubani olungisela igwababa ukudla kwalo, lapho amaphuphu alo ekhala kuNkulunkulu, ezulazula ngokuswela ukudla, na?

39.1: “Uyazi yini isikhathi sokuzala kwamagogo, uqaphela ukuzala kwezindluzelekazi, na?
39.2: Ungazibala izinyanga eziziqedayo, uyasazi isikhathi ezizala ngaso, na?
39.3: Ziyakhonkobala, zizala amazinyane azo, zikhiphe okwemihlelo yazo.
39.4: Amazinyane azo aqina, akhulela endle; ayahamba, angabe esabuyela kuzo futhi.
39.5: “Ngubani ovumele imbongolo yasendle ukuba ihambe; ngubani owathukulula izintambo zayo,
39.6: engenza ihlane libe yindlu yayo, nezwe likasawoti libe yindawo yayo yokuhlala, na?
39.7: Ihleka umsindo wedolobha, ingezwa ukumemeza komshayeli.
39.8: Okufunyanwa ezintabeni kuyidlelo layo: ifuna zonke izinto eziluhlaza.
39.9: “Inyathi iyakuthanda ukukhonza, ihlale ebusuku emkhombeni wakho, na?
39.10: Ungayibophela inyathi ngentambo emseleni, ibhuqe izigodi emva kwakho, na?
39.11: Ungayethemba, ngokuba amandla ayo makhulu, ushiye umshikashika wakho kuyo, na?
39.12: Ungakholwa yiyo ukuba ibuyise imbewu yakho, iyibuthele esibuyeni sakho, na?
39.13: “Amaphiko entshe ayaphaphaza, kepha angamakhombe nezimpaphe zothando na?
39.14: Ngokuba iyashiya amaqanda ayo emhlabathini, iwafudumeze othulini.
39.15: Iyakhohlwa ukuthi unyawo lungawachoboza nokuthi isilwane sasendle singawanyathela.
39.16: Iphatha kalukhuni amazinyane ayo, kungathi awasiwo awayo; ayinangebhe yokuthi umshikashika wayo ungaba yize.
39.17: Ngokuba uNkulunkulu wayenza ukuba ikhohlwe ukuhlakanipha, akayabelanga ukuqonda.
39.18: Lapho indizela phezulu, ihleka amahhashi nabagibeli bawo.
39.19: “Nguwe onika ihhashi amandla alo, wembathisile intamo yalo umhlwenga oyephuzelayo, na?
