39.20: Ulenze ukuba lixhume njengenkumbi na? Indumo yokuthimula kwalo iyesabeka.
39.21: Liyaphanda ezigodini, liyesasa ngamandla alo, liyaphuma ukuhlangana nezimpi.
39.22: Liyahleka ingebhe, alesabi, alibuyi phambi kwenkemba.
39.24: Ngolaka lwalo nangokufutheka kwalo liyagwinya umhlabathi; alimi ngokukhala kwecilongo.
39.25: Ekuzwakaleni kwecilongo lithi: ‘Nakho-ke;’ lihogela ukulwa kusekude, nendumo yezinduna nokumemeza kwazo.
39.26: “Uklebe uyandiza ngokuqonda kwakho, awelulele ngaseningizimu amaphiko akhe, na?
39.27: Ukhozi lwenyukela phezulu ngezwi lakho, lwakhe isidleke salo phezulu, na?
39.28: Luhlala esiweni, lwakha khona, eweni ledwala eliyinqaba yalo.
39.29: Lulapho luhlola ukudla kwalo; amehlo alo akubona kusekude.
39.30: Amazinyane alo amunca igazi; lapho kukhona abagwaziweyo, lukhona nalo.”

40.2: “Osolayo uyakuphikisana noSomandla na? Omkhuza uNkulunkulu makaphendule.”
40.4: “Bheka, angiyinto yalutho; ngingakuphendula ngokuthini na? Ngibeka isandla sami emlonyeni wami.
40.5: Ngikhulumile kanye, angisayikuphendula, yebo, kabili, kepha angiqhubeki.”
40.7: “Bopha izinkalo zakho njengendoda; ngizakukubuza, wena ungazise.
40.8: Imbala uyachitha ukwahlulela kwami, ungilahle ukuba ube ngolungileyo, na?
40.9: Unengalo njengoNkulunkulu, ungaduma ngezwi elinjengelakhe, na?
40.10: Zihlobise ngobukhosi nangokuphakama, wembathe udumo nenkazimulo.
40.11: Thulula ukuphuphuma kwentukuthelo yakho, ubheke bonke abazidlayo, ubathobise.
40.12: Bheka bonke abaziphakamisayo, ubehlise phansi, unyathele ababi ezindaweni zabo.
40.13: Bafihle othulini kanyekanye, ubophe ubuso babo endaweni ethukusiweyo.
40.14: Khona ngiyakukudumisa nami ngokuthi isandla sakho sokunene singakusindisa.
40.15: “Ake ubheke uBehemoti* engamenza kanye nawe; uyadla utshani njengenkabi.
40.16: Bheka-ke, amandla akhe asezinkalweni zakhe, nezikhwepha zakhe zisemisipheni yesisu sakhe.
40.17: Uqinisa umsila wakhe njengomsedari;* imisipha yamathanga akhe yalukene.
40.18: Amathambo akhe anjengemibhobo yethusi; izimbambo zakhe zinjengemigoqo yensimbi.
40.19: Ungowokuqala wezidalwa zikaNkulunkulu; ekwenziweni waphiwa inkemba yakhe.
40.20: Izintaba ziyamvezela ukudla, lapho kudlala khona izilwane zonke zasendle.
40.21: Ulala phansi kwezihlahla ezinomthunzi ekusitheni kwemihlanga nasemaxhaphozini.
40.22: Izihlahla ezinomthunzi ziyamsibekela ngomthunzi wazo; iminyezane yasemfuleni iyamphahla.
40.23: Bheka, noma kuphuphuma umfula, akethuki; uyaqalaba, noma iJordani ligijigijimela emlonyeni wakhe.
40.24: Angabanjwa ebhekile, liqhunjuzelwe ikhala lakhe umkhala, na?

41.1: “Ungakhipha uLeviyathani* ngodobo, ucindezele phansi ulimi lwakhe ngentambo, na?
41.2: Ungafaka igoda lomhlanga ekhaleni lakhe, ubhoboze umhlathi wakhe ngodobo, na?
41.3: Uyakwenza imikhuleko eminingi kuwe, akhulume kuwe amazwi athambileyo, na?
41.4: Uyakwenza isivumelwano nawe ukuba umthathe abe yinceku kuze kube phakade na?
41.5: Ungadlala naye njengenyoni, umbophele amantombazana akho, na?
41.6: Abathengi bangathengiselana ngaye, bamahlukanise phakathi kwabahwebi, na?
41.7: Ungagcwalisa isikhumba sakhe ngezinhlendla, nekhanda lakhe ngamathatha ezinhlanzi, na?
41.8: Beka isandla sakho kuye; khumbula ukulwa; awusayikukuphinda.
41.9: Bheka, ithemba lakho liyakhohlisa; nangokumbona nje uyawiswa phansi.
41.10: Akakho onesibindi sokumvusa. Ngubani, pho, ongema phambi kwami na?
41.11: Ngubani ongandulele ukuba ngimbuyisele na? Konke okuphansi kwezulu kungokwami.
41.12: “Angiyikuthula ngezitho zakhe, nangendaba yamandla akhe, nangesimo sakhe esihle.
41.13: Ngubani ongakhumula isambatho sakhe esingaphandle; ngubani ongangena phakathi kwemihlathi yakhe emibili na?
41.14: Izicabha zobuso bakhe ngubani ongazivula na? Amazinyo akhe ayesabeka nxazonke.
41.15: Umhlane wakhe uyizinhla zezihlangu; zinamathelisiwe njengangophawu.
41.16: Zisondelene esinye kwesinye, kungangeni moya phakathi kwazo.
41.18: Ukuthimula kwakhe kubengezela ngokukhanya; amehlo akhe anjengezinkophe zokusa.
41.19: Emlonyeni wakhe kuphuma izihlanti, nezinhlansi zomlilo ziyaqhasha.
41.20: Emakhaleni akhe kuphuma umusi njengasesocweni esibilayo nasemihlangeni eshayo.
41.21: Ukuphefumula kwakhe kokhela amalahle, nelangabi liphuma emlonyeni wakhe.
41.22: Entanyeni yakhe kuhlala amandla, nengebhe iyaxhuma phambi kwakhe.
41.23: Amanya enyama yakhe anamathelene; abunjiwe kuye, awanakususwa.
41.24: Inhliziyo yakhe iqinile njengetshe, yebo, iqinile njengetshe lokusila elingaphansi.
41.25: Ekuvukeni kwakhe abanamandla bayesaba; ngenxa yevuso baphela amandla.
41.26: Noma inkemba ifinyelela kuye, ayinakusiza, noma umkhonto nomcibisholo nengcula.
41.28: Umcibisholo awunakumxosha; amatshe endwayimana aphenduka amabibi kuye.
41.29: Izagila uzishaya amabibi; uyahleka ukugunquza kwengcula.
41.30: Ingaphansi lakhe linjengezindengezi ezibukhali; uyenaba njengesibhuqo odakeni.
41.31: Wenza inzulu ibile njengekhanzi; wenza ulwandle lufane nomfuma wamafutha.
41.32: Wenza umgudu ukhazimule emva kwakhe; kungathi utwa lungwevu.
41.33: Emhlabeni akukho okufana naye owenziwa abe ngongesabiyo.
41.34: Ubona konke okuphakemeyo; uyinkosi phezu kwabo bonke abantwana bokuzikhukhumeza.”

42.2: “Ngiyazi ukuthi ungenza konke; alinakuvinjwa icebo lakho.
42.3: Ngubani ositheza iziluleko engenakwazi na? Ngikhulumile lokho ngingakuqondanga, izimangaliso ezinkulu kunami ebengingazazi.
42.4: “Ake ungizwe, kukhulume mina; ngiyakukubuza, wena ungazise.
42.5: Ngangizwile ngawe ngokuzwa kwezindlebe, kepha manje iso lami liyakubona.
42.7: Kwathi lapho uJehova esekhulumile lawo mazwi kuJobe, uJehova wathi ku-Elifazi umThemani: “Intukuthelo yami iyavuthela wena nabangane bakho ababili, ngokuba anikhulumanga okulungileyo ngami njengenceku yami uJobe.
42.8: Ngalokho zithatheleni izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa nezinqama eziyisikhombisa, niye encekwini yami uJobe, nizinikelele ngazo zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; uJobe inceku yami uyakunikhulekela, ngokuba uma ngivuma ubuso bakhe, angiyikwenza kini njengobuwula benu, lokhu ningakhulumanga okulungileyo ngami njengenceku yami uJobe.”
42.9: Base behamba u-Elifazi umThemani, noBilidadi umShuhi, noSofari umNahama, benza njengokukhuluma kukaJehova kubo; uJehova wavuma-ke ubuso bukaJobe.
42.10: UJehova wambuyisa uJobe ekuhluphekeni, lapho ekhulekela abangane bakhe; wenezela kukho konke uJobe ayenakho ngokukuphinda kabili.
42.11: Kwase kufika kuye bonke abafowabo, nabo bonke odadewabo, nabo bonke ababazana naye ngaphambili, badla endlini yakhe; bamkhalela, bamduduza ngakho konke okubi uJehova amehlisele khona, yilowo nalowo wamnika uhlamvu lwemali necici legolide.
42.12: Kanjalo uJehova wabusisa ukugcina kukaJobe kunokuqala kwakhe; waba nezimvu eziyizinkulungwane eziyishumi nane, namakamela ayizinkulungwane eziyisithupha, namabhangqa ayinkulungwane ezinkabi, nezimbongolo zezinsikazi eziyinkulungwane.
42.14: Wabiza igama leyokuqala ngokuthi uJemima, negama leyesibili ngokuthi uKesiya, negama leyesithathu ngokuthi uKereni Haphuki.
42.15: Ezweni lonke akufunyanwanga abesifazane abahle njengamadodakazi kaJobe; uyise wabanika ifa phakathi kwabanewabo.
42.16: Emva kwalokho uJobe wayesekhona iminyaka eyikhulu namashumi amane, wabona amadodana akhe namadodana amadodana akhe kwaze kwaba yizizukulwane ezine.
